stories.title: Two-storey house collapses after blast in Varanasi:3 injured, firecracker factory owner flees with mother
stories.summary: An explosion in firecrackers caused half of a two-storey house to collapse in Varanasi on Thursday evening. The blast was so powerful that a neighbouring house was also damaged. The incident took place at around 5 pm in the densely populated Paigambarpur area. Firecrackers were allegedly being manufactured and stored illegally at the house without a licence. Following the incident, teams from the police, the State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) and the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) reached the spot. Before their arrival, neighbours had rescued three people from the house and taken them to hospital. The condition of the mother and son is critical. The house owner, Raju Khan, and his 65-year-old mother, Munni, were reportedly not found at the scene. Both had fled before the police arrived. According to eyewitnesses, the explosion was so powerful that they felt as though an earthquake had struck. Neighbours claimed that they had previously complained to the police about the illegal firecracker factory. See pictures related to the incident… Read the full story A powerful explosion occurred on Thursday evening at an illegally operated firecracker factory in the Paigambarpur area of Panchkoshi, Sarnath. The blast was so intense that the house was reduced to rubble. Around 6 members of firecracker trader Raju Khan's family, including Khan himself, were reportedly trapped under the debris. The explosion terrified nearby residents and triggered panic in the area. As soon as the incident was reported, Sarnath police, the fire brigade and an NDRF team reached the spot. Raju Khan's son Adil (16), Chandni (39) and Arabia (10) were injured in the explosion. They have been admitted to the divisional hospital. Raju had been released from jail only a few days ago Raju Khan and his mother, Munni Khan, reportedly fled through the back door. Raju had been released from jail only a few days ago. An explosion occurred in the Jalalipura area 40 years ago, in which Raju was jailed and his father, Matiullah Khan, died. The force of the blast can be gauged from the fact that the outer portion of the neighbouring house also collapsed. The explosion spread panic among residents of nearby houses, and a crowd gathered at the scene. Given the presence of firecrackers inside the house and the possibility of further explosions, rescuers were proceeding cautiously during the operation. Bombs were being made next to our house: Neighbour Neighbour Sunil Kumar said, “Bombs were being made next to our house. There has been a bomb blast. Our house is right beside it. I have just returned from duty. My family would know about it. I have only just come back from work. We had lodged complaints. The police also came and conducted raids several times. But what can we do? Nothing happened.” The road was shaking violently, Eyewitness Eyewitness Pankaj said, “I live here. There was an illegal firecracker manufacturing factory here. A blast occurred. We were walking along the road when the explosion happened in that lane. It was so loud that it felt like an earthquake. The road was shaking violently. We were passing by when a boy, Raju Khan's son, told us, ‘There has been a blast at our house. My grandmother, mother and other family members are trapped inside.’” DCP says handmade firecrackers were found Varuna Zone DCP Rajesh Pandey said, “We received information at 5 pm that a two-storey house had collapsed. When we reached the spot and inspected the site, we found handmade firecrackers scattered around. It is suspected that an incident of this kind occurred while firecrackers were being manufactured, causing the house to collapse. “There was initially no clear information about anyone being injured, but it is being reported that a woman may be trapped under the debris. The SDRF, NDRF and our fire service team are conducting a rescue operation, as you can see, to remove anyone who may be trapped. Since the police arrived, no other information about injuries has been received.”

stories.title: Cricketer Rinku Singh’s dog goes missing in Aligarh:Went out for a walk, sister appeals for help
stories.summary: Cricketer Rinku Singh's pet dog, Brudo, has been missing since October 12. The five-year-old Labrador went out for his morning walk as usual but did not return home. The family searched for him in their housing society, the nearby park and surrounding areas, but could not find him. CCTV footage showed Brudo leaving the house and heading towards a nearby park. However, the family has been unable to trace him since then. On Wednesday evening, Rinku's sister, Neha Singh, shared Brudo's pictures and videos on social media in Aligarh and appealed to people to help find him. Rinku and his brother brought Brudo home when he was 15 days old Rinku Singh's elder brother, Sonu Singh, said, "When Brudo was just 15 days old, Rinku and I brought him home. He is now five years old and has been living with the family ever since. Whenever Rinku is at home, Brudo spends most of his time with him." The family lives in the Golden State housing society in the Ozone City complex in Aligarh. Brudo is not just a pet to them but a member of the family. His disappearance has left everyone at home worried and upset. Went for his usual morning walk but did not return Brudo usually went for a walk in a nearby park at around 10 am every morning. On October 12, he left home as usual but did not return. The family began searching for him around the society, in the park and near houses that were under construction. They also asked two or three nearby families if they had seen him, but found no clues. Family watches four hours of CCTV footage Sonu Singh said the CCTV footage showed Brudo leaving the house and heading towards a nearby park. The family watched around four hours of footage but could not find any information about where he went after that. They suspect that someone may have taken him away, although this has not been confirmed. According to Sonu, the family is currently searching for Brudo on its own and has not yet informed the police. If they are unable to find him, they will consider seeking police help. Rinku Singh has also been informed about Brudo's disappearance. Sister appeals to people to help find Brudo On Wednesday, Neha Singh shared Brudo's picture on social media and appealed to people to help locate him. "Our Brudo has been missing since yesterday. He went missing from Ozone City, where we live. We searched extensively for him, but have not found any trace of him yet," she said. Neha added that Brudo has a red belt around his neck, which can help people identify him. She requested anyone who spots him to contact the family as soon as possible, take a picture and send it to her through a direct message. She also said her social media ID had been shared in the caption. The family is hoping that someone who has seen Brudo will come forward and help bring him home.

stories.title: Elderly man falls for woman 45 years younger:Couple gets engaged in Auraiya; she says they will marry after Navratri
stories.summary: The relationship between 75-year-old Ramsugar and 30-year-old Reena Rajput in Auraiya, Uttar Pradesh, has been making headlines due to their 45-year age gap. According to their neighbours, the two got engaged about a week ago and are now preparing for their wedding, while a video of their engagement has surfaced on Instagram, prompting mixed reactions from users, with some calling it a stunt to gain views and others describing it as true love that transcends age. See 3 pictures... Elderly man's daughter said, "Reena used to visit our house" Reena Rajput is an Instagram blogger. She is a resident of Dayalpur in the Sadar Kotwali area of Auraiya district. Ramsugar, meanwhile, is a resident of Ariyari village in the Sahar area of the district. Following their engagement, preparations for their wedding are now being discussed. According to Ramsugar, Reena Rajput had been visiting his house for the past two years. During this time, the two grew close and he fell in love with Reena. Ramsugar's daughter Radha is also a YouTuber. Radha said that her mother died about seven years ago. Rani used to visit their house. They would all shoot videos together. During this time, her father and Rani developed feelings for each other. Claim that the engagement took place at a beauty parlour According to Radha, her father Ramsugar and Rani Rajput got engaged at a beauty parlour in Auraiya around a week ago. Preparations are under way to conduct their wedding according to traditional rituals. However, no clear information has emerged on when the wedding will take place. Various reactions to this alleged love story are emerging on social media. While some people are calling it true love that transcends age barriers, others consider it a stunt to increase views and popularity on Instagram. There is also speculation that activities related to the engagement were being filmed at a beauty parlour. However, this has not yet been confirmed. Reena says-Age does not matter in love Reena said she had no objection to the age gap and was extremely happy with the decision. She believes that age has no significance in love and that anything is possible. Ram Sugar and she are both fully prepared for this relationship. According to Reena, she and Ram Sugar are already engaged, but the exact wedding date has not yet been decided. The date will be finalised after Navratri, following which the two will get married in a grand ceremony.

stories.title: Muskan cries in Meerut jail after death sentence:Refuses food, gets prisoner number 396; boyfriend Sahil works in fields
stories.summary: Muskaan Rastogi and her lover Sahil, who were sentenced to death in the Saurabh murder case in Meerut on Wednesday evening, are now subject to the prison’s new rules as convicted prisoners, with Thursday marking their first day in this category. Muskaan has been assigned prisoner number 396, while Sahil has been given number 395; she has reportedly been in shock since the sentencing, cried throughout the night and refused to eat, following which prison authorities arranged counselling for her during the night. She asked the counsellor, "What will happen to us now? Is there any way to escape the death penalty?" On Thursday morning, she wore the cream-coloured suit issued to female prisoners. Muskaan is also desperate to meet her elder daughter, Pihu. She will write a letter to her parents for this. Meanwhile, Sahil has begun adapting to the new rules. On Thursday morning, he wore the prisoners' uniform – a white kurta-pyjama. He worked in the fields alongside the other prisoners. Muskaan cried all night and did not eat either As soon as Muskaan and Sahil were sentenced to death on Wednesday evening, they were sent to their respective barracks. At night, the jail authorities shifted Sahil to barrack number 15 for prisoners sentenced to death. Muskaan, who is staying with her 11-month-old daughter, has been kept in her old barrack, 12-B, for now. After the sentence was announced, Sahil and Muskaan reached their respective barracks and did not eat dinner. Sahil lay down after reaching his new barrack, but Muskaan continued crying. Muskaan had breakfast but left more than half of it On Thursday, Sahil and Muskaan got up at 6:30 a.m., along with the other prisoners and detainees. Even while everyone was being counted, Muskaan was seen sitting in the barracks and crying. Some time later, when she saw the prisoners receiving breakfast, Sahil also took his meal. Muskaan, however, did not even look at the breakfast. She was counselled again afterwards. Only then did Muskaan take her breakfast. However, she could not finish it and left more than half of it. According to jail sources, Muskaan is far more distressed than Sahil after being sentenced. She starts crying over the slightest thing. At times, she cries when she looks at her daughter, while at other times, she curses herself. Muskaan was also the one who asked the counsellor the first question. Muskaan told counsellor, "How can I escape the gallows?" Muskaan is desperate to meet her elder daughter. The jail authorities do not have any contact number for Muskaan's family. She has therefore been told to write a letter. Muskaan will soon send a letter from jail to her parents, pleading with them to arrange a meeting with her daughter. Muskaan's elder daughter is with her maternal grandparents. Her younger daughter was born in prison and is with Muskaan. Muskaan asked the counsellor, "What will happen to me now? I have two young daughters. Is there any way to avoid the death penalty?" The counsellor then explained the entire process of appealing in a higher court. Only then did Muskaan calm down. Sahil went to work in the fields with prisoners in the rain In the jail, Muskaan is being referred to as Prisoner No. 396 and Sahil as Prisoner No. 395. Both will also have to work like the other inmates. Muskaan will do sewing and embroidery with the women. Sahil, meanwhile, has been assigned to look after the vegetables in the fields. Despite the rain on Thursday morning, Sahil went to work in the fields with the other inmates. Monitoring of Both Increased, Counselling Schedule Set Senior Jail Superintendent Dr Viresh Raj Sharma said, "Monitoring of Muskaan and Sahil's barracks was increased late on Wednesday night itself. Counselling for both of them has also begun. Sahil is returning to normal, while Muskaan will take some time. Muskaan's counselling schedule has been finalised. She is receiving counselling twice a day. Both of them are also undergoing medical check-ups twice a day." Read how Muskaan murdered Saurabh

stories.title: 2 videos of millionaire Shiva emerge after Shraddha:Lucknow model says, 'I'll call police next time'
stories.summary: Two videos of Lucknow millionaire businessman Shiva Sharma, recorded before his death, surfaced on Thursday. In the videos, a woman is threatening Shiva. She is claimed to be Shraddha Dubey, although the police have not confirmed this so far. Shraddha accuses him of stealing three gold chains and a bracelet. She asks Shiva to return around ₹6 lakh. Shiva assures her that he will return the money. He says, "I am giving it in writing that I will return the money. Keep my car and give me the money." In the video, he can be heard saying that he will return the money within a month. Find out what both VIDEOS contain... FIRST VIDEO: I will return the money within a month Shraddha: When did you steal from my place? What time did you do it? Was it in September or October? When was it? I am asking you very politely. I have not called the police yet. I will call them after this, but first you tell me. Shiva: In September... and when I was going to the washroom... Shraddha: What was I doing in the washroom? Approximately how long did it take me? Shiva: It took around 20-25 minutes. Shraddha: It took 20-25 minutes, so did you steal the jewellery all at once or in separate instances? Shiva: I took them together. Shraddha: Together? Three chains and a bracelet? Shiva: Yes. Shraddha: Where did you sell them? Shiva: At Chowk. Shraddha: Whose shop at Chowk? Shiva: I sold them inside the Gol Darwaza area at Chowk. I do not know which shop it was, because the boy took me there and sold... I mean, the items... Shraddha: He sold them and gave you the money? Shiva: (He nods in agreement.) Shraddha: So the total value of my money is around ₹6 lakh. By when will I get it back? Shiva: You will get it within a month. Shraddha: Does your mother know about this? Shiva: No. Shraddha: That you stole them? Shiva: No one knows. Shraddha: No one knows anything about this? Shiva: Nobody knows. Shraddha: Really! And I am not forcing you to make this video, am I? Brother, you admitted it yourself... Shiva: Yes, I did not have it made... SECOND VIDEO: Shiva said, "Keep my car" Shraddha: When will you return the money? Shiva: Within one month. Shraddha: Really! Shiva: So I will give it to you in writing. Until then, please keep my car. I will pay the money and take my car back. Shraddha released a VIDEO for Shiva's mother, said: "You lost your son, I lost my boyfriend" Accused model Shraddha Dubey has fled to Nepal. She has released three videos from there so far. In the third video, she is heard telling Shiva's mother, "You have lost your son; I have lost my boyfriend." In the video, Shraddha appealed to the media not to spread rumours about the case. She claimed that Shiva's mother had accused her and other people of murder without knowing the full details of the incident. Shraddha questioned why anyone would push someone from their own apartment. Shraddha claims: Shiva was under pressure to repay debts According to Shraddha, Shiva had borrowed money from several people. The lenders used to call him. Shraddha claims that Shiva would tell her that if he failed to repay the loans, he would commit suicide. Shraddha said the two had met before the incident. According to her, Shiva called her and asked to meet. They went to a café, where Shiva ordered coffee for her and juice for himself. They then went to Shraddha's home. Shraddha explained what happened on the morning of 9 October According to Shraddha, the two woke up and made tea on the morning of 9 October. Shiva then went to the bathroom and locked the door. Shraddha claims that after some time, his sister opened the door, after which Shiva jumped from the balcony. Shraddha also accused Shiva's mother of arguing with his driver at the hospital. She said the incident would have been recorded on the hospital's CCTV cameras. Now read the full account

stories.title: Rajnath Singh distributes relief kits to flood-hit residents in Lucknow:Says he came to assure them 'we stand with you', not deliver a speech; promises 10,000 more kits
stories.summary: Defence Minister and Lucknow MP Rajnath Singh arrived in Lucknow on Thursday. He distributed relief materials to 1,000 flood-affected families in the Faizullaganj area of the city. He spoke to residents and enquired about their well-being. Addressing them from the stage, he said, “I have not come here to deliver a speech. I have come to tell you that we stand with you.” He added that another 10,000 relief kits would be distributed. A stage was set up for Rajnath Singh in flood-hit Daudnagar. A green carpet had been laid over the floodwater up to a point some distance from the stage, where the Defence Minister arrived in his convoy. He then inspected the relief camp and met flood-affected residents, enquiring about their well-being. Before his arrival, the roads along his route had been dried using several pumping sets. Rajnath Singh to attend these programmes over 3 days Lucknow BJP metropolitan president Anand Dwivedi said that after meeting flood-affected people, the Defence Minister will meet representatives of social organisations at his residence on Kalidas Marg tomorrow. He will then visit the homes of bereaved families in different parts of the city to meet their relatives and offer his condolences. At 6 pm, he will attend a Durga Puja programme at Ram-Ram Bank Chauraha in Sector E, Jankipuram. After the programme, he will return to his residence and stay there overnight. On the final day of his visit, 17 October, Rajnath Singh will again meet representatives of social organisations at his residence. He will then leave for Lucknow Airport at 11.30 am and return to Delhi from there.

stories.title: Bonded doctors lie at police officers’ feet in Lucknow:ACP sits on ground with folded hands; urges them to end protest
stories.summary: Bonded doctors staged a protest in Lucknow on Thursday as well, demanding equal pay. Earlier, the doctors had arrived with stethoscopes around their necks and tape over their mouths; they were seen pleading with the police with folded hands and lying at their feet. The doctors said they had been protesting for 42 days, but their demands had still not been accepted. When the doctors began moving towards the Chief Minister's residence from 1090 Chauraha in a human chain, the police stopped them. As the doctors began sitting on the road, the ACP himself sat on the ground. With folded hands, he asked the doctors to end their protest. It may be noted that during the protest on 2 September, Health Minister Brajesh Pathak had assured the doctors that equal pay would be implemented. 4 pictures from the protest ... Doctors said: Give us one bond, one salary A large number of bonded doctors took part in the protest. They were carrying placards that read "One Bond One Salary" and "Give justice to bonded medical officers". The police and doctors continued arguing for a considerable time. The police accused the doctors of staging a demonstration without permission and blocking the road. The doctors, however, said they were protesting democratically for their rights. They alleged that the Deputy Chief Minister had promised to provide equal pay, but the promise has not yet been fulfilled. The doctors said they had been protesting over their demands for the past 42 days. Despite this, no concrete solution has been found. The Deputy Chief Minister had met the doctors on 2 September Bonded MBBS doctors from the 2018, 2019 and 2020 batches of government medical colleges are staging the protest. The doctors say they are being paid different salaries despite having the same degrees, bonds and service conditions. They are demanding pay parity and payment of their outstanding arrears. They say Deputy Chief Minister Brijesh Pathak had assured them on 2 September that their demands would be met and a government order would be issued within 24 hours. The government order has not been issued yet. Doctors travelled 300 km to take part in the protest Protesting doctor Akshay said he had come to Lucknow from Mirzapur. It is very difficult for him to take part in the protest after coming from another district. He travels around 300 kilometres to attend, but is disappointed every time. He said, "The Deputy Chief Minister had promised to fulfil our demands within 24 hours, but that did not happen." Akshay said, "We are doctors. We are called gods, but we do not receive the same respect. If we were truly considered gods, we would not be treated this way." ₹50,000 salary, other doctors receive ₹1.10 lakh Dr Nida, who came from Deoria, said they had taken to the streets out of compulsion. Under the bond service, they must complete two years of compulsory service or meet the obligation of a ₹10 lakh bond. During this period, they are posted at CHCs, PHCs and other government health facilities in rural and remote areas. In return, they receive an honorarium of around ₹50,000 to ₹55,000 per month. Doctors' demand: If the degrees are the same, why the difference in salaries? Doctors claim that some doctors serving bonds at government medical colleges under the same MBBS degree, bond, counselling and selection process are being paid up to ₹1.10 lakh per month. Calling this disparity in pay, the protesting doctors are demanding the implementation of equal pay scales and payment of outstanding arrears.

stories.title: A 52-year-old lawyer was shot dead in Prayagraj's Karnalganj police:Wife alleges he was killed in front of police, demands death for death; CCTV shows attackers with faces covered
stories.summary: A 52-year-old lawyer was shot dead in Prayagraj's Karnalganj police station area around noon on Thursday. He was shot in the abdomen and collapsed on the ground, covered in blood. He was rushed to SRN Hospital, where doctors declared him dead. The lawyer's wife, Varsha, alleged that her husband, Satish Srivastava, was shot in front of the police. Demanding strict action against the accused, she said they should be killed in an encounter. "I want blood for blood and death for death," she said. Family protests for four hours, demands action Following the murder, the lawyer's family protested for around four hours, demanding action against those responsible. The family members calmed down after DCP City Sagar Jain assured them of appropriate action. The body was then sent for a post-mortem examination. Accused is also a lawyer; CCTV footage emerges According to the police, the accused, Devendra Nath, is also a lawyer. CCTV footage of one of the attackers has emerged, showing the assailants leaving the scene with their faces covered. Police are investigating the case. Here is the full story in detail The lawyer, his wife and daughters were at college Satish Kumar Srivastava, who lives in Salori, has a wife, Varsha, and two daughters, Vaishnavi and Vaishali. Satish Kumar Srivastava was a lab attendant at Ishwar Sharan Degree College, around 200 metres from their home. His wife Varsha teaches at an intermediate college. Their daughter Vaishnavi is also a teacher at a private college. Varsha Srivastava said, "Devendranath Mishra has been trying to occupy our land for the past year. We had also submitted petitions in this matter to several officials, including Chief Minister Yogi, the DCP and the ACP." "Those people were also involved in an incident with my daughter on 10 December. We had gone to Gorakhpur and met Yogiji. He had consoled us and assured us that action would be taken. However, DCP Vivekchandra Yadav was siding with the accused." Wife says, "The attackers entered the house and vandalised it" Today, my husband, I and my daughters were at college. The house was locked. At around 12 noon, my husband called me and said that Devendranath Mishra had entered the house in Salori with several people. He told me to reach there quickly, saying that they were also on their way. We rushed home. We saw Devendranath vandalising our house with around 20 people. They had broken the boundary wall of the plot behind the house. We objected, after which he pushed my husband and then attacked him with an iron rod. His son Nipendranath Mishra, alias Bachchu, Amarendranath Mishra, alias Anupam, and 7-8 other people were with him. Devendranath's wife was also there. All of them pelted stones at us. They knocked me to the ground, beat me with kicks and punches, and attacked me with a chair. Shot her husband in the stomach with a revolver The wife said, "After this, Amarendranath took out a revolver. He shot my husband in the stomach. Outpost in-charge Vinay Yadav also assaulted my husband. I want an FIR to be registered against the accused and for them to be killed in an encounter." Varsha said, "The land belongs to us. I have all the documents. Devendranath had asked me to give him space to park his car. We had been friends for 50 years, so my husband allowed him to park his car. He continued parking it there for two years. After that, Devendranath began encroaching on the land. When the dispute escalated, we went to the police and the court. How was I to know that he would turn into a scorpion?" Family members created a ruckus for four hours Meanwhile, as soon as news of Satish Srivastava's murder reached them, his fellow lawyers and family members arrived at the scene. They left the hospital carrying Satish's body, saying that the funeral would not take place until the accused were killed in an encounter. As soon as they received the information, DCP Yamunanagar Vivekchandra Yadav and DCP City Sagar Jain reached the scene. They tried to persuade the family members. Meanwhile, a heated exchange also took place between the police officers, lawyers and family members. Satish's daughter Vaishnavi told the DCP, "When we went to you with a complaint, you scolded us and sent us away. My father was shot in front of the outpost in-charge. The attackers had climbed onto my house." The family members remained firm for about four hours, demanding action while carrying the body. They later calmed down after police officers assured them that action would be taken. DCP says three teams have been formed; some accused detained DCP Vivekchandra Yadav said, "Devendranath Mishra and Satish Srivastava had been embroiled in a dispute over Nazul property for some time. Devendranath is an Additional Government Advocate (AGA). At around 11:45 a.m. on Thursday, Devendranath arrived at the disputed property." There, he broke the lock that had already been put up by Satish Srivastava's side. A dispute then broke out between the two sides. During the incident, firing was carried out by Devendranath Mishra's side. One bullet struck Satish Srivastava in the abdomen. He sustained serious injuries. His family took him to Raj Nursing Home. Given his critical condition, he was referred to Swaroop Rani Nehru (SRN) Hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Following a complaint by Satish's family, a case has been registered at Colonelganj police station. Some of the accused involved in the incident have been detained and are being questioned. Three police teams have been formed to search for the other accused. CCTV footage from the surrounding area is also being examined. Following the registration of the case, anyone found guilty during the investigation will be arrested.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav inducts Brij Bhushan's close aide into SP:Says 'See no evil, hear no evil' on absconding model Shraddha Dubey
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has once again accused the Election Commission of working for the BJP. He said only those who are BJP members are being registered as voters. The Election Commission is treating only BJP members as citizens of India. With the support of the commission and the administration, BJP workers are carrying out large-scale fraud. At a press conference at the Samajwadi Party office on Thursday, Akhilesh listed 10 of the BJP's electoral tactics. He said the BJP's tactics include getting fake votes added, getting opponents' votes deleted, having guns pointed on polling day, tampering with EVMs, rigging the vote count, issuing a certificate of victory to a losing candidate, creating divisions within the Opposition, and forming a government by breaking up the Opposition. key points from Akhilesh Yadav's press conference 1- BJP hides behind the Election Commission when it starts losing elections Akhilesh said that when the BJP appears to be losing or weakening among the people, it hides behind the Election Commission. The two are jointly deceiving the Constitution and the people. He said that since 2022, he had been repeatedly alleging that the Election Commission was working at the BJP's behest. Preparations are being made for a large-scale scam with the administration's support. 2- The commission is not even sharing information The SP chief said party workers had worked to stop alleged attempts at manipulation within the administration. More than 100 forms had been filled out in Sarojini Nagar in the name of Dashrath. The Election Commission had to accept that the complaint was valid. In Sultanpur, applications were submitted to have Nandlal's name removed from the electoral roll using forged signatures. 3- Akhilesh claims: 19 lakh fake voters detected Akhilesh Yadav claimed that, in addition to the 16 lakh fake voters identified so far, another three lakh had been detected. This brought the total number of fake voters detected to 19 lakh. He said the highest numbers had been created in Loni, at 15,000, and Sahibabad, at 13,000. Akhilesh alleged that the most irregularities were being carried out in places where the BJP believed it was losing the election. The SP had lost Moradabad by 722 votes. Therefore, 8,000 fake voters had been added there so far. He claimed that fake voters were being added in places where the BJP's defeat appeared certain. 4- 29 BLOs died during SIR Akhilesh said that 10 fake votes had been created in the name of a young man in Azamgarh. That person will cast one vote, while BJP workers will get the remaining nine votes cast. He said that 29 BLOs had died during the entire process. It is now being reported that the entire SIR process has been nullified. He said 87 lakh Form 6 applications had been submitted. As many as 84,000 names had been added. Information about 67,000 names was made public, while the remaining information was not shared. 5- Fraud may work in by-elections, but we will not allow it in all 403 constituencies Akhilesh Yadav said that 420-style fraud might work in the by-election, but he would not allow it in 403. The BJP will lose and flee. God himself will defeat liars. He alleged that not a single person from the PDA community had been assigned election duty. The BJP was resorting to tactics such as getting fake votes added, having the names of opponents removed and arranging food and drink before voting. 6-The Election Commission's credibility has been destroyed Asked about the Supreme Court issuing a notice, Akhilesh said that the Election Commission should still resign. The Commission's credibility has been destroyed. It appeared to be standing with the BJP. He alleged that the Kundarki election had been looted. Akhilesh said that people have the right to march and hold sit-ins in a democracy. Wherever political leaders sit, that place will become Jantar Mantar. 7- Workers should remain at booths on 17 and 24 October Akhilesh appealed to workers to remain at the booths on 17 and 24 October to prevent fake voters from being added and ensure that the names of those left out are added to the electoral roll. He said the Election Commission had launched a special campaign on these dates. Everyone would have to remain cautious at every step. A total of 120 forms had been submitted through a person named Dashrath. He questioned why voter lists were not linked to Aadhaar when the government had complete data. 8- For the first time, so many gods have joined our party together Bhavani Shukla of Gonda joined the Samajwadi Party along with his five sons. His sons are named Shri Bhagwan Shukla, Krishna Bhagwan Shukla, Shiv Bhagwan Shukla, Vishnu Bhagwan Shukla and Shankar Bhagwan Shukla. Akhilesh Yadav said, "For the first time, so many Bhagwans have come together to the party office. No one in our society can forget these names. Sanatanis, in particular, can never forget them." Akhilesh thanked Bhavani Shukla for joining the SP. The joining of Vinay Purari, Meerut BSP leader Manmohan Singh Saini and some leaders from Gonda was also mentioned during the event.

stories.title: Former IAS officer Divya Mittal launches new political party:Names it Jan Neeti Bharat, will contest the election from Mirzapur Sadar
stories.summary: Former Uttar Pradesh IAS officer Divya Mittal has announced the launch of her own political party. The party has been named ‘Janniti Bharat’. In a video posted on Facebook at 1 pm on Thursday, she announced that she will contest the 2027 Assembly elections from the Mirzapur Sadar constituency. Divya Mittal said: In Janniti Bharat, the rule will be yours. Janniti Bharat will contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections. The government will run according to your wishes for five years. Earlier, on September 30, Divya Mittal had announced her entry into politics. She had said that she would remain in Uttar Pradesh, would not be afraid and would continue to raise questions. She had also said that she would not join any political party and would walk alone. Her aim, she said, was not to change politicians but to change the entire political system. “I do not want money or muscle power,” she had said. Divya, a 2013-batch IAS officer, had written on Facebook two days ago, on Tuesday, that she would announce the next step in her political journey on October 15. Since then, there had been speculation about her future plans. Divya had studied BTech at IIT Delhi and an MBA at IIM Bengaluru before taking up a high-paying job in London. Here is what Divya Mittal said in the video, word for word: 1. First pledge of ‘Janniti Bharat’ — From people to policy, from policy to India Divya Mittal said, “I am forming my own political party. You may ask, are there not enough political parties already? There is no shortage of parties; there is a shortage of people being heard. “I am standing in front of the Ganga. In the Ganga, every drop is equal. All the drops together determine the course. I want to build a party in the same way, where every person is a drop and every drop has a role. The party that has emerged from this idea is called ‘Janniti Bharat’. “In Janniti Bharat, the rule will be yours. Janniti Bharat will contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections. The government will run according to your wishes for five years — not just for one day, but at every step. “Janniti Bharat has three pledges. People will be at the centre of the country’s policies and people themselves will decide the policies. “You may remember Devkali Devi. Despite not having water at home, she had asked me for a school. After my video, work on the school began. The foundation was being laid, but then it was discovered that the land belonged to the forest department, so the work was stopped. The children whose future was supposed to be built on that foundation are still waiting. “The question is, when the country’s biggest industrialists need a road to be built, the forest gives way in 80 days. But when a poor person needs a school, a road or a factory, why does that file remain pending for 80 years? “The second policy is justice — where everyone is heard. Ask the people where they should get justice. Ask the people how policies should be made. A mother eats one less roti but makes sure her child has enough to eat. A father cuts down on his own expenses but sends his child to school. This is the kind of thinking our policies will reflect. “There will be a farming policy with farmers at the centre. Farmers know what problems they face from the field to the mandi and where prices collapse. Similarly, trade policy will focus on small traders and the problems they face from their businesses to the ports. “A girl is looking at the moon from the roof of her house today. One day, she will reach it.“The first pledge of Janniti Bharat — from people to policy, from policy to India.” 2. Every decision will be based on need, not identity “The second pledge of Janniti Bharat — every decision will be based on need, not identity.” She said, “A road was being built and hope had emerged in the village. Then someone pointed a finger and changed the direction of the road. On one side, thousands of people would have benefited; on the other, there was one person. The road was diverted towards the other side, where there were hundreds of houses. Courtyards were destroyed and homes were demolished. The road was built for someone. “In Janniti, everyone will be able to point to a location on the map. If there is a dark stretch where girls are afraid to pass, where will they report it? They will mark the location on a mobile app. When 100 people mark the same spot, there will be lights, patrolling and cameras there. The decision will not be taken by the police or a politician, but by those girls. “Whether it is a hand pump, a road or a paved lane, people will point out where the work is needed most and work will begin there. There will be no caste, religion or status involved. Everyone will decide together.” 3. Decisions based on need and equality in decision-making The third pledge of Janniti Bharat is — decisions based on need and equality in decision-making. She said, “The public will keep an account of every piece of work. At present, people do not even know about the work, while the middleman gets to know first. “A woman applied for a permanent house, but she did not know that her house had been approved. A middleman came to her and said, ‘Mother, I will get it done. Give me Rs 5,000.’ If the woman knows about the approval first, then who will the middleman approach? “Every piece of work carried out in that village through any fund should be visible on a mobile phone. But what happens now is that the person who carried out the faulty work is asked whether everything was done properly. What answer will he give? He will say everything is fine. “If you give children their own notebooks to check, they will say everything is fine. Who is the first person to know that a road is in bad condition? The people who use that road. “If we use three colours for a bad road — green means good, yellow means average and red means bad — the same colours can be used for places people depend on every day, such as schools, hospitals and ration shops. “Were books provided at the school? How was the teaching? The same three colours. These three colours can be used for hospitals as well. These three colours can cover the entire block and district. The officer will know, the minister will know and the entire district will know. “This is the third pledge of Janniti Bharat — the public will have the right to demand an account, and that accountability will lead to improvement.” 4. We will fight together — not do politics, but practise Janniti She said, “If you are going to do everything yourselves, then what will the MLAs do? What will the MLAs of Janniti Bharat do? The MLA’s job will be to go to your doorstep. To write for those who cannot write and to mark things on the phone for those who cannot do it themselves. “Today, the MLA sits between the people and the government, but faces the government. In Janniti Bharat, the MLA will sit in the same place, but will face the people. “You may ask, if this is so easy, why has it not happened until now? There is a phone in every hand. If train tickets can be booked on a phone, why can’t this be done on a phone? Because the question here is not about convenience, but about power. “The person who takes Rs 5,000, the person who leaves a road incomplete, the person who investigates his own wrongdoing and the person who changes the direction of a road are not different people. They are the four legs of the same chair. “I had said earlier that you are the sun. The sun does not need anyone’s permission to rise. The day the sun rises, the rule will belong to every person. “This party has neither money nor s. Therefore, this fight will not be fought through posters, but from house to house. Every house will be an office and every person will be a campaigner. “Invite me to your village or town as well. We will fight this battle together. “I had said earlier that you are the sun. I have opened one window; you open three more windows. Send this video and message to three people and write three words — ‘Not politics, but Janniti.’” Four days ago, she visited Mirzapur for the first time after announcing her entry into politics Earlier, Divya Mittal had reached Mirzapur on Sunday, the first day of Navratri. It was her first visit to the district after announcing her entry into politics. Her supporters gave her a grand welcome. Slogans of “Divya Didi Zindabad” were raised. Women presented her with garlands of roses and showered flowers on her. Divya became emotional when people touched her feet. She told the people, “You have weighed me down with flowers and garlands. This is your love. You make me emotional every time. It feels as if Mirzapur has taken a contract to make me cry. Mirzapur should always keep smiling. No one should cry.” Divya Mittal was Mirzapur DM and had helped bring water to Lahuriyadah Divya Mittal became the District Magistrate of Mirzapur in September 2022. She was discussed for her work involving public outreach programmes and drinking-water initiatives in rural areas. The initiative to provide piped water to Lahuriyadah village was also undertaken during her tenure. Her farewell after she was transferred from Mirzapur also attracted attention. She was given a farewell in the presence of local residents. Later, her tenure in Deoria also made headlines after a dispute over powers between elected representatives and the administration. After resignation was accepted, she wrote — ‘Move forward, move forward’ Former IAS officer Divya had resigned from service on August 30. Her resignation was accepted on September 14. After her resignation was accepted, Divya wrote, “My resignation from the IAS has been accepted.” She also quoted lines from poet Jaishankar Prasad’s play Chandragupta: “Prashast punya panth hai, badhe chalo, badhe chalo.” “Prashast punya panth hai” means that the path of protecting and gaining freedom for the motherland is vast, clear and sacred. “Badhe chalo, badhe chalo” is a call by the poet to the brave sons and soldiers of the country to continue moving forward on this sacred path without stopping or being afraid. Divya left her London job to join the civil services Divya is originally from Rewari in Haryana. After studying at IIT and IIM, she worked in London. She met Gagandeep Singh there. The two had a love marriage. However, after a few years, the couple left their jobs in London and returned to India. Divya began preparing for the UPSC examination. She cleared the IPS examination on her first attempt without coaching and was allotted the Gujarat cadre. She continued preparing for the IAS examination even during her IPS training. The following year, in 2013, she was selected for the IAS. Divya’s husband is from Punjab, cleared UPSC in his first attempt Divya’s husband Gagandeep Singh’s family is from Gidderbaha in Punjab’s Bathinda district. He studied chemical engineering at IIT Delhi from 1998 to 2002 and management at IIM Bengaluru from 2003 to 2005. Gagandeep cleared the UPSC examination on his first attempt in 2010 and was selected for the Indian Trade Service. Four years ago, in 2022, he resigned as Joint Director General in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

stories.title: Model accused of murder says Shiva died by suicide:Claims she saw him jump with her own eyes; releases three videos from Nepal in 12 hours
stories.summary: Another video of model Shraddha Dubey, accused in the murder of Lucknow millionaire businessman Shiva Sharma, has emerged. Shraddha, who has fled to Nepal, has released her third video in the past 12 hours. In the video released on Thursday, she says, "It was not murder; it was suicide. I saw him jump with my own eyes." "If the CCTV cameras there are checked, everything will come out. It will show how he jumped. It is not that we are not distressed. At that time, I was in no condition to say anything. My health deteriorated badly because someone from my house attempted suicide, so it was natural for my condition to worsen." 7 October incident This happened on the 7th, when Shiva, through a tea seller in Kapurthala... There is a tea seller at Kapurthala's main crossroads where we used to often have tea. Through him, Shiva had my driver called. Shiva Sharma and I had had no contact for, let us say, six or seven days before the 7th. We had not spoken for five or six days. He had my driver called through the tea seller. During that call, he was crying a lot. Then I called him twice from my number. He did not answer at the time. At 2:00 a.m., I received a call from Shiva. I asked him, "What happened? Why are you crying?" He said, "Where are you?" I replied, "I am standing at Dainik." He came to Dainik in his BMW and met me. He also said on the call-if the call details are obtained, they will show that he said, "Babu, I am coming, okay?" He came and spoke with me. He had drunk a lot of beer, okay? We went to Paddlers Café. At Paddlers Café, he ordered matcha for me and juice and other things for my driver, and got something for himself as well. After that, he went home with me. We drove home as we usually did. He was driving my car, while my driver was driving his car, okay? Reference to his sister's arrival and meeting friends After 7, on 8... Navratri was approaching, and it was on 11. My sister came to my house on 8 to discuss something related to the puja. She came to my house in the morning on 8. My sister has absolutely no connection with this case. She did not even know Shiva well. If her call details are obtained, they will show that she had neither spoken to Shiva nor anything else. She knew very little about Shiva Sharma. My sister... my sister had absolutely nothing to do with it. She had come to my house after so many days, okay? Even when my sister came on the 8th, we continued to relax and everything remained fine. We went out. In the evening, some of Shiva Sharma's friends came, one of whom was named Ashwini Mishra and the other Harsh. If Shiva Sharma had been subjected to any kind of torture or anything else, why did his friends not go to the police and report that he was being tortured? There was no such torture; nothing of the sort happened to Shiva. Shiva and I were happy and were doing very well. I had known Shiva Sharma for only two months; he had been my friend for four months. We had been in a relationship for the past two months, so we knew each other, okay? He... His mother said that he lived with me in a live-in relationship. Sometimes he stayed for 15 days, and sometimes he would disappear for two to four days; that is what he used to do. Five days before I met him, when we were not in contact, he had gone to Kedarnath or somewhere else on a trip with his sister and brother-in-law. Claim of debt and suspicion of suicide I have some screenshots that I will share with you. They clearly show that Shiva had accumulated a huge debt-outstanding loans of ₹15 lakh to ₹20 lakh. Whenever he sat with us, calls from creditors would start coming in. If his call records are retrieved-I have sent Shiva Sharma's phone to the police-and everything is checked, they will show that Shiva Sharma was receiving calls from a large number of creditors. He had become so troubled by his debt that he would tell me, "If I am unable to repay the debt, I might even commit suicide." Right? He was extremely distressed, but at the time we were taking what he said lightly. Just think for yourself: why would a girl kill someone and throw them down from her own flat, right? So, my request to the media is: please do not spread such things or circulate such rumours about anyone. I was not in that condition because, while our driver and we were rushing around, her mother arrived there. We called her mother, 112 and 108. Her mother arrived and then began assaulting my driver there, which will have been recorded on the hospital's cameras, all right? Without knowing anything, she directly accused us of murder. I mean, without thinking or finding out the facts, she immediately blamed us for murder. She made such a serious allegation against us that we may never be able to escape that blame for the rest of our lives, all right? Reference to the events of 8 and 9 October So, on the 8th, we... and on the 9th, we remained normal as well. On the 8th, we went out and drove around, going on a long drive. During that time, there were several conversations with Shiva Sharma, her mother, her brother-in-law and her sister. Calls came in in front of me, and conversations took place, all right? Then, on the 9th, he was depressed-I do not know myself what was going on. When we wake up, we have tea served in the drawing room. Shiva went inside to use the washroom, but whenever he went to the washroom, he never closed my main gate. As soon as he closed the main gate, I became suspicious because he had already told me that he had so many debts. I immediately sent my sister to go and check what he was doing. By the time my sister opened the gate, he had jumped from the balcony. It is not as though you have lost your son; I have lost my man too. I am also extremely distressed. Please, I request the media not to harass me, please. You have lost one life, and if you continue to torture me like this, I will kill myself. I really will kill myself.

stories.title: Model Shraddha Dubey escapes police again:Nepal CCTV surfaces; cops suspect insider leak
stories.summary: Police are searching for model Shraddha Dubey, an accused in the murder case of Lucknow resident Shiva Sharma, after she allegedly crossed into Nepal with her sister and a friend. CCTV footage reportedly shows the three heading towards a bus station in Nepal after leaving their SUV near the India-Nepal border. Two videos featuring Shraddha have also surfaced from Nepal, in which she claims to be innocent. Police suspect that she is receiving information about their investigation and movements. Investigators are trying to find out who is helping her evade arrest and how she is getting updates about the police operation. Meanwhile, Shraddha's Instagram followers have increased from around 141,000 to 142,000 since the incident, while the number of accounts she follows has fallen from 421 to 410. Police teams fail to trace her in Sitapur and Lakhimpur Three teams from the Lucknow Police Crime Branch and Hazratganj police station are searching for Shraddha. The teams include an inspector, six sub-inspectors and 16 police personnel. According to the police, when a team reached Sitapur to find her, she had already left. Her location was subsequently traced to Lakhimpur, but the police failed to find her there as well. Investigators believe Shraddha travelled to Rupaidiha on the India-Nepal border with her sister, Rashmi, and friend Adil. Her Scorpio SUV was found abandoned in a private parking area. The three allegedly crossed the border on foot and reached Mahim Nagar in Nepal. CCTV footage reportedly shows Shraddha, Rashmi and Adil crossing a road and entering a bus station. They are believed to have spent the night there before leaving by bus the following morning, before the police team arrived. Who is leaking information about the police operation? Investigators suspect that Shraddha is receiving updates about police movements and the progress of the investigation. According to police sources, screenshots containing information about the reward announced for her arrest and other developments may also have been sent to her. The police are trying to identify those allegedly passing on the information. Action may be taken against them if their involvement is established. The release of two videos while Shraddha remains at large has also raised questions about who is helping her record and circulate the clips. In the videos, she claims to be innocent. The police are investigating how she is obtaining information about the case and whether anyone is helping her evade arrest. Instagram followers increase after the incident Shraddha's Instagram account has also drawn attention since the case came to light. Her follower count reportedly increased from around 141,000 to 142,000, while the number of accounts she follows dropped from 421 to 410. The report suggests that some high-profile accounts may have been blocked or unfollowed. However, it is unclear whether Shraddha herself made these changes. Shraddha's sister Rashmi also remains on the run Rashmi Dubey, Shraddha's sister, is also absconding in connection with the case. According to details emerging during the investigation, Rashmi previously worked at a private bank. She later became interested in social media influencing after seeing her sister's growing popularity, reels and large following. Rashmi began posting more actively on social media. Her Instagram account reportedly features videos of her dressing up and attending late-night parties. The report also describes her as someone who enjoys parties and hookah. See three pictures of Shraddha's sister... What happened in the Shiva Sharma murder case? On 9 October, Shiva Sharma died after falling from the fourth floor of Awadh Green Apartments in Lucknow's Hazratganj area. He had reportedly been living with Shraddha in a live-in relationship for the previous four months. According to the report, Shiva was found wearing only underwear, with lipstick on his face and several cigarette burn marks on his body. His mother, Ranjana Sharma, filed a murder complaint against five people, including Shraddha, her sister Rashmi and their driver, Adil. The family has alleged that Shraddha pushed Shiva from the fourth floor. The allegation is part of the ongoing investigation and has not been established in court. stories.title: Weekly special train to run between Udaipur and Delhi Sarai:Six trips each way from October 21 to November 26 to ease festive rush
stories.summary: To meet the rising demand for train travel during the festive season, the Railway has decided to operate a weekly special train between Udaipur and Delhi Sarai. The special train will make six trips in each direction between 21 October and 26 November. The train will depart from Udaipur at 9:15 p.m. every Wednesday and from Delhi at 1:45 p.m. every Thursday. The operation of this new train will make it much easier for thousands of passengers travelling to and from Delhi from areas around Udaipur, Chittorgarh, Bhilwara, Ajmer and Jaipur to get confirmed tickets during major festivals such as Diwali and Chhath. North Western Railway Chief Public Relations Officer Amit Sudarshan said that train number 09617, the Udaipur City-Delhi Sarai weekly special, would operate from 21 October to 25 November. The train will depart from Udaipur City at 9:15 p.m. every Wednesday and reach Delhi Sarai station at 11:15 a.m. the following day. Special train to operate on the return journey from 22 October On the return journey, train number 09618 Delhi Sarai-Udaipur City Weekly Special will operate from 22 October to 26 November. The train will depart from Delhi Sarai at 1:45 p.m. every Thursday and reach Udaipur City at 4:00 a.m. the following day. The special train will stop at a total of 14 major stations in both directions along the route. These include Mavli, Chanderiya, Bhilwara, Bijainagar, Ajmer, Kishangarh and Phulera. It will also halt at Ringas, Neem Ka Thana, Narnaul, Ateli, Rewari, Gurugram and Delhi Cantt stations. The halt at Ringas will directly benefit devotees travelling to Khatu Shyamji. A total of 22 coaches have been attached to the train for passengers' convenience. It caters to passengers travelling in every class, from AC to general. The train will have two Second AC, six Third AC and two Third AC Economy coaches. In addition, it will have six Sleeper Class and four General Class coaches. It will also include one guard coach and one power car.

stories.title: 31kg of cannabis worth ₹15 lakh hidden in animal feed:One arrested in Varanasi; stock intended for festival supply
stories.summary: The Varanasi Police Commissioner has directed the Varanasi police to crack down on drugs ahead of the festival. Acting on these instructions, Siga Police in Varanasi on Wednesday surrounded the area near the old iron tank in Pachpedwa and arrested a notorious interstate smuggler. The smuggler had brought a consignment of ganja to Varanasi concealed in a vehicle carrying animal feed. It was intended to be sold during the festivals. The 31-kilogram consignment of ganja has been valued at ₹15 lakh. The arrested smuggler, Rajkishore Gaur, is a resident of Buxar, Bihar. He also supplies ganja under the guise of transporting animal feed. He will be sent to jail on Thursday. Siga police lay trap near Pachpedwa Siga Inspector Shivakant Mishra said while revealing details of the case that the police had received information from an informer that a large consignment of prohibited narcotics was being brought into the city in a pickup vehicle for sale. As soon as they received the information, the Siga Police team went on alert and intensified checking near the old iron tank in Pachpedwa. Meanwhile, police signalled a goods-laden pickup vehicle approaching under suspicious circumstances to stop. On seeing the police, the driver tried to flee, but the alert police team cordoned off the area and caught him at the spot. Smuggler from Bihar, cannabis packed in 30 packets Police questioning and investigation revealed that the arrested accused was identified as Rajkishore God. Inspector Shivakant Mishra said the accused, Rajkishore God, was a resident of Nawadera in Bihar's Buxar district. He had been involved in the illegal trade for a long time and supplied narcotics across the border. When police thoroughly searched the seized pickup vehicle, they found 10 sacks of animal feed (cattle feed) loaded inside it. At first glance, it appeared to be an ordinary goods vehicle. However, when police removed the sacks of animal feed and checked underneath, they recovered 30 packets of cannabis hidden there. Weighing revealed that the total quantity of cannabis seized was 31.275 kilograms. New method of smuggling The inspector said that during questioning, the shrewd criminal revealed that he constantly adopted new tactics to evade the police. This time, he used animal feed as a cover to deceive the police. Animal feed has a strong odour of its own, which easily masks the smell of cannabis. The accused hoped that the police would see the sacks of bran and let the vehicle pass without checking it, but his plan failed due to the vigilance of the Sigra police.

stories.title: Passenger arrives at Lucknow airport with gold hidden in underwear:Arrives from Sharjah carrying 472g gold in multiple pouches
stories.summary: Customs officials at Lucknow’s Amausi airport have seized gold worth around Rs 70 lakh from a passenger arriving from Sharjah. On Wednesday, officials noticed the passenger limping and approached him for questioning. He appeared nervous and gave evasive answers. During a search, officials found 472.100 grams of gold in paste form packed inside a plastic pouch and concealed in his underwear. He had tied the pouch around his waist like a waistband to avoid suspicion. The seized gold was valued at Rs 70,81,500. Officials have seized the gold and detained the passenger, identified as Kedar Mahto, a resident of Gopalganj in Bihar. He is being questioned to determine who had instructed him to bring the gold to Lucknow and to whom he was supposed to deliver it. Here is the complete sequence of events: Gold suspected to have been brought in without paying customs duty Officials suspect that the passenger concealed the gold to bring it into the country without paying customs duty. Further investigation is underway to examine other aspects of the case.

stories.title: Cross-examination of witness completed in Gorakhpur:Confirms shop CCTV footage in case involving rape and murder of 10-year-old girl
stories.summary: In the case involving the abduction, rape and murder of a 10-year-old girl from Gorakhpur District Hospital, the defence completed its cross-examination of witness Ashhar Jameel on Wednesday. He proved in court the footage from the CCTV cameras installed at his plywood shop on Bank Road. During the investigation, the police had secured this footage on a pen drive. The defence began its cross-examination after the witness's examination-in-chief was recorded on Tuesday, but it remained incomplete due to a lack of time. The remaining questions and answers were completed on Wednesday. Special Public Prosecutors Raghavendra Tripathi and Ram Milan Singh represented the prosecution in the case. Brijesh Singh, the defence's Chief Legal Aid Defence Counsel, and Deputy Counsel Bhagat Gaur questioned the witness. The court has scheduled 15 October for the next hearing in the case. CCTV footage proved in court Ashhar Jameel, who runs a plywood shop opposite V-Mart on Bank Road, confirmed the CCTV camera footage from his shop in court on Tuesday. The police had preserved the footage on a pen drive during the investigation. According to the prosecution, the footage is important evidence in the investigation of the case. On Wednesday, the defence continued questioning the witness. His cross-examination was completed. Witness questioned for two days Special Public Prosecutors Raghavendra Tripathi and Ram Milan Singh recorded Ashhar Jameel's examination-in-chief on Tuesday. The defence lawyers then began cross-examining him. The entire process could not be completed on Tuesday due to a lack of time. On Wednesday, the defence asked the remaining questions and completed the witness's cross-examination. The next hearing in the case will be held on 15 October. What is the full case? On the night of 28 July, a 10-year-old girl went to Gorakhpur District Hospital to give food to her elder sister, who was admitted there. During this time, the girl suddenly went missing. When her family began searching for her, they learnt that a young man wearing a police uniform had taken her with him. Police then advanced the investigation with the help of CCTV footage and surveillance. The investigation indicated that constable Abhishek Yadav, a resident of Ghazipur and posted with Dial 112, was accused of abducting the girl. Body found along the Rohin River in Rohin on 30 July According to police, during interrogation in custody, the accused confessed to raping and killing the girl. The girl's body was recovered on 30 July along the Rohin River in Chiutaha. After the case came to light, the accused constable was dismissed from service and sent to jail. The hearing in the case is now proceeding in court on the basis of witness statements and evidence.

stories.title: UP weather to change, rain alert in 23 districts:Flood-hit Lucknow still has up to 4 feet of water in lanes; 10 new dengue cases reported
stories.summary: Weather conditions are set to change once again in Uttar Pradesh. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an alert for thunderstorms, rain and hail over the next 48 hours. Lightning is also likely in several areas. Manoj Srivastava, a weather scientist in Varanasi, said, A fresh western disturbance has become active over the hilly regions, while easterly winds are bringing moisture from the Bay of Bengal. Under its influence, the rain system has strengthened over western UP today. Tomorrow, eastern and central UP may receive rain accompanied by strong winds. After that, the weather will clear up. Meanwhile, floods continue to trouble Lucknow. Although the water level in the Gomti has started falling, more than 3 lakh people in the Faizullaganj area remain affected. Homes have remained inundated with 3–4 feet of water for the 19th consecutive day. Boats are still operating in the streets and localities. The risk of dengue is also rising, with 10 new cases reported in the past 24 hours. Water enters more than 40,000 homes The floods have affected thousands of families. According to information, three to four feet of water has entered more than 40,000 homes. As a result, a population of more than 3 lakh people has been affected. With water entering their homes, people are facing a crisis in meeting their everyday needs. In several areas, people are struggling to reach safe locations and arrange essential supplies. Normal movement has been disrupted as roads and lanes are flooded. Several families are trapped in their homes and are also finding it difficult to buy essential supplies. Due to the persistent waterlogging, people are worried about stagnant water, filth and the spread of diseases in their homes.

stories.title: Brother-in-law dies by suicide after sister-in-law’s settlement at panchayat:Shoots himself in head in Sultanpur; she was refusing to live with her husband
stories.summary: In Sultanpur, a brother-in-law shot himself in the head after returning from a panchayat meeting concerning his sister-in-law. At the panchayat meeting in Jaunpur, a settlement had been reached between the sister-in-law's husband and her parental family, but her brother-in-law Digvijay did not agree with the decision. After returning home on Tuesday (13 October), he shot himself in the head with his father's licensed rifle. On Wednesday, his four-year-old son performed his father's last rites. Digvijay had gone to the panchayat meeting alone. His wife said that after returning home, he did not tell her anything about what had happened at the meeting. She said that as soon as her mother called, Digvijay went into the room and shot himself. The incident took place in the Lambhua area, around 37 km from the district headquarters. What exactly happened at the panchayat that left Digvijay upset? Read the full report... Read what happened... Digvijay shot himself with a rifle in Sultanpur on Tuesday evening. He had returned home from his in-laws' house just 10 minutes before the incident. Hearing the sound of the gunshot, his wife ran to the room, where she found her husband writhing on the floor, covered in blood. His wife telephoned the family and informed them about the incident. The family then took the young man to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. At the time of the incident, only the young man's wife and children were at home. On Wednesday evening, his four-year-old son performed his father's last rites. Had 18 bighas of land under cultivation Digvijay Singh (32), son of Lal Pratap Singh, lived in Dhanecch village and worked in agriculture. The family owned 18 bighas of land. Digvijay was the only son of his parents. His father, Lal Pratap Singh, also worked in agriculture but has been paralysed for 10 years. Digvijay married Amrita Singh, a resident of Sunjanganj in Jaunpur, eight years ago. Digvijay and Amrita had three children - Dhruvi (6), Surbhi (5) and their youngest son, Shaurya (4). Two years ago, Digvijay arranged the marriage of his sister-in-law Moni to Ayush, who also lived in the village. Ayush's house is 400 metres from Digvijay's home. Moni and Ayush began arguing soon after their marriage. Had tried several times to broker a reconciliation Initially, Digvijay tried several times to reconcile the two. However, six months ago, Moni left her marital home and returned to her parents' home. Digvijay made several attempts to reason with both sides, but no solution was found. Since Digvijay had arranged the marriage, he convened several village councils in an effort to persuade his sister-in-law to continue living at her marital home. Moni had made it clear that she would not live with Ayush. Ayush, too, had said that he would no longer go to bring Moni back. On Tuesday, Ayush was travelling to Jaunpur to try to reach a settlement. Digvijay also went to his in-laws' home to attend the village council. Both were supposed to travel there from the village, but they went separately. Digvijay was not in favour of brokering a settlement Talks of a settlement between Moni and Ayush began in Jaunpur. Digvijay was no longer in favour of a settlement. He said that after the panchayat and repeated efforts to reason with them had failed, the two should now live separately. When Digvijay refused, his mother-in-law and Ayush abused him. Ayush and Moni agreed to live together. When Digvijay returned home, he was angry. After reaching home, he did not tell his wife anything. He had not even changed his clothes. Just then, his mother-in-law called again from her home. As soon as he answered, Digvijay hurled an abuse and handed the mobile phone to his wife, Amrita. Amrita went to the tractor parked outside the house and began talking on the phone. Shot himself with his father's licensed rifle Digvijay went inside the house and took out his father's licensed rifle. He shot himself in the head. He fell to the ground covered in blood immediately after being shot. His wife rushed inside and raised the alarm. Local residents and family members took him to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. The body was sent for a post-mortem examination on Wednesday. On Tuesday night, former BJP MLA Devmani met the family and consoled them. Neighbours said that Digvijay owned around 18 bighas of land and worked as a farmer. Last year, he took out a loan to buy a tractor for farming. He had now begun preparing to repair the house. He was the family's sole breadwinner A villager said that 10 years ago, Digvijay's father, Lal Pratap Singh, shot himself in the leg to frame another villager. He has been paralysed ever since and remains bedridden. Digvijay was the family's sole breadwinner. Cousin Sonu Singh said that Digvijay had arranged his sister-in-law's wedding in this village. After talks in Alaiya village, a settlement was reached to bring the woman back. After returning home from her in-laws' house, he shot himself. I was in the fields when my nephew called. We took him to hospital, but he died. Lambhua CO Hrithik Kapoor said The body was handed over to the family after the post-mortem. No written complaint has been received from the family so far. The matter is being investigated.

stories.title: मायावती की अस्थियों को भी खुद से दूर नहीं रखे जाने की वसीयत लिख गए हैं कांशी राम
stories.summary: राजनीतिक भागीदारी सुनिश्चित करने के उद्देश्य से बसपा ने अस्तित्व में आते ही चुनावी लड़ाई में हाथ आजमाना शुरू कर दिया था। जिस साल (1984) पार्टी बनी, उसी साल मायावती और कांशी राम ने लोक सभा चुनाव में अपनी उम्मीदवारी रख दी थी। उस चुनाव में पार्टी को देश भर से 10.05 लाख वोट मिले थे। मायवाती कैराना (जिला मुजफ्फरनगर, पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश) और कांशी राम जांजगीर (तब मध्य प्रदेश, अब छत्तीसगढ़ में) से उम्मीदवार थे। उस समय बसपा को चुनाव आयोग से मान्यता नहीं मिली थी। लिहाजा दोनों ने पार्टी के समर्थन से निर्दलीय चुनाव लड़ा था। मायावती 44,445 वोट लाकर तीसरे नंबर पर (कांग्रेस और लोक दल के बाद) रही थीं और कांशी राम ने भी नौ फीसदी वोट लाकर अच्छी दस्तक दी थी। फिर 1985 में बसपा ने पंजाब में विधान सभा चुनाव लड़ा। वैसे इस चुनाव में भी पार्टी जीत नहीं सकी, लेकिन इसने कांग्रेस के करीब 24 फीसदी वोट काट लिए। पार्टी 30 सीटों पर लड़ी थी। इनमें से नौ पर उसकी जीत हुई थी।

stories.title: Cylinder blast blows off house roof in Agra:Fire breaks out while cooking; son burnt trying to save mother
stories.summary: A gas cylinder caught fire while food was being cooked in Agra. People tried to put out the fire, but the cylinder exploded. The blast blew off the roof of the house. Two women were trapped in the fire. One woman's son suffered burns while trying to rescue his mother. Two women and a young man were injured in the fire. Fire brigade personnel reached the spot after being informed and extinguished the fire. The injured were admitted to hospital for treatment. The incident took place in Nagla Gangaram under the Lohamandi police station jurisdiction. See three pictures... Now read the full incident Sonu owns a house in Gangaram Nagar. Tenant Bablu and his three brothers live there with their families. Police said that Manju, the daughter-in-law of Bablu's mother Mithilesh, was cooking food at around 8 p.m. on Thursday night. The gas pipe leaked and came loose. As a result, gas began escaping rapidly from the regulator. A stove was burning nearby, causing the cylinder to catch fire. Mithilesh and Manju were trapped in the flames inside the room. Just then, Mithilesh's younger son Bablu arrived. He entered the room through the flames to save his mother. He brought his mother, Mithilesh, outside. He then went back to bring Manju out. Her sari had caught fire, but he pulled her out as well. Also burned while trying to save his mother Bablu was also burned while trying to save his mother. Sonu's wife Renu, the landlord's wife, was also caught in the fire. However, she was not injured. Neighbours who arrived after hearing the commotion tried to put out the fire. However, the cylinder exploded with a loud blast. The blast blew off the roof of the house. People informed the police and fire brigade. Firefighters extinguished the blaze. All the household belongings were destroyed in the fire. The injured women have been admitted to hospital. Residents said the sound of the cylinder explosion was extremely loud. People living nearby were shaken.

stories.title: 4 rebel SP MLAs to join BJP:Event in Amethi on October 14; Rakesh Singh says, 'We cannot stay with those who oppose Ram and the nation'
stories.summary: Rebel Samajwadi Party MLA Rakesh Pratap Singh will join the BJP on 14 October. He announced this himself on Thursday. Along with Rakesh Singh, three other rebel SP MLAs - strongman Abhay Singh, Rakesh Pandey and Vinod Chaturvedi - will also join the BJP. Abhay represents the Gosainganj seat in Ayodhya, Rakesh Pandey represents Jalalpur in Ambedkar Nagar, and Vinod represents the Kalpi Assembly constituency in Jalaun. All four MLAs won the 2022 election on SP tickets. However, they voted for the BJP candidate in the 2024 Rajya Sabha election. Speaking to the media at 12 p.m., Rakesh Singh said, "We cannot go along with anyone who does not stand with Ram and the nation." He said several BJP leaders, including former MP Smriti Irani and state president Pankaj Chaudhary, would be present at the programme to be held in Gauriganj. They will join the party along with thousands of workers on 4 October. The BJP will win in Gauriganj, Amethi, in 2027, after 21 years. Rakesh Pratap Singh says-Cannot do anti-religion politics On his decision to join the BJP, Gauriganj MLA Rakesh Pratap Singh said that he had been a Samajwadi Party MLA three times. He said that around three years ago, while still in the SP, he had raised his objection. He said that they had not entered politics to hurt religious sentiments or debate issues related to religion. They had entered politics for the development of Uttar Pradesh and to help the poor and disadvantaged. But his words were ignored. I could not tolerate this, so I rebelled. I cannot do politics with people who are hostile towards religion. For me, this is neither about a ticket nor about the post of MLA. I have taken this decision after rising above all these considerations. Violated party whip, Akhilesh expels 3 In the Rajya Sabha election in Uttar Pradesh in February 2024, 7 Samajwadi Party MLAs crossed party lines and cross-voted in favour of BJP candidates. The incident came as a major setback for the SP. As a result, the SP's third Rajya Sabha candidate lost, while all 8 BJP candidates won. The MLAs who cross-voted included Abhay Singh, Rakesh Pratap Singh, Manoj Pandey, Pooja Pal, Vinod Chaturvedi, Ashutosh Maurya and Rakesh Pandey. The Samajwadi Party had expelled Rakesh, Abhay and Manoj from the party. There are still four MLAs against whom the SP has taken no concrete action. The most prominent name among them is Pooja Pal. Manoj Pandey later joined the BJP as well. He is currently a minister in the Yogi government. Now, get to know the four MLAs... Rakesh Pratap Singh: Won elections three times on an SP ticket Abhay Singh: Known as a strongman leader in Purvanchal Vinod Chaturvedi: Won his first election in 2007 Rakesh Pandey: Brother a former MLA and son a former MP Understanding the political arithmetic of Gauriganj, where the membership programme will be held Rakesh Pratap Singh is set to hold a major programme in his constituency ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. His consecutive victories in Gauriganj in three elections and the narrow margin over the BJP in 2022 make this change significant in the context of local politics. However, the party has not yet made any official announcement about his role or ticket in 2027 after he joins the BJP. In the 2024 Lok Sabha election, Congress candidate Kishori Lal Sharma received 1,08,426 votes in the Gauriganj Assembly constituency, while BJP's Smriti Irani received 75,048 votes. The difference between the two was 33,378 votes. Against this backdrop, attention will remain on the local political equations in Gauriganj following Rakesh Pratap Singh's entry into the BJP ahead of 2027.
