stories.title: Akhilesh unwilling to give more than 55-60 seats:Congress builds pressure with smaller parties; how complicated is seat-sharing?
stories.summary: The seat-sharing issue between the Samajwadi Party (SP) and Congress for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections is becoming increasingly complicated. Congress wants to resolve the matter within October itself. For the first time, the party’s working state president and MP Imran Masood has softened his stance and is now demanding “respectable seats”. On the other hand, SP MP from Pratapgarh Shivpal Singh Patel has described Congress’s demand for 150 seats as completely impractical. He argued that the SP has around 125 MLAs in UP, while Congress has only two. Therefore, Congress’s actual standing is limited to 10-20 seats. Even giving it 50 seats would be a very big concession. Congress is trying to put pressure on the SP by bringing smaller parties in UP into its fold. The question is, why have Akhilesh Yadav and Congress’s top leadership, including Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi, not been able to hold talks on seat-sharing? Even after keeping itself away from the leadership change in UP Congress and the MLC elections, why has the party still been unable to secure the seats it wants from the SP? Read the full story… Congress has come down from 200 to 150 seats, now demanding respectable seats Congress had initially demanded 200 seats from the SP for the UP Assembly elections. State in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam had even described Congress as the “elder brother”. He had said that there would be no compromise on anything less than an equal share. However, Congress leaders have been gradually softening their stance. The same UP in charge who had demanded 200 seats is now talking about 150. On October 7, working UP Congress president Imran Masood made it clear by talking about a respectable number of seats that Congress has now completely bowed before the SP. By not fielding candidates in the MLC elections, Congress has already sent a message that it is not going against the SP. The question is, how many seats does Congress actually want? Senior journalist Hisam Siddiqui provides the answer. He says Congress wants to re-establish itself in UP. This will only be possible if it has at least one strong face in every district. Therefore, Congress is trying to contest 75-80 seats in the UP Assembly elections. It wants one seat in every district and more than one seat in districts such as Amethi, Rae Bareli and Saharanpur. In other words, the “respectable” number of seats for Congress is being considered to be between 75 and 80. Why is it difficult for the SP to fulfil this demand from Congress? Congress’s organisational base in UP is no secret. In several districts, its organisation is virtually non-existent. Senior journalist Rajendra Prasad says the SP is contesting the 2027 Assembly elections in UP with the aim of forming the government. It also knows that if it misses the opportunity in 2027, it could meet the same fate as Mamata Banerjee, Uddhav Thackeray and the DMK. As of today, the SP is Congress’s strongest ally in the INDIA bloc. The BJP is trying to weaken the alliance further by defeating a strong ally like the SP in UP. This is why the SP is assessing every single seat this time. If the SP gives Congress 75-80 seats as per its demand, only 320-325 seats would remain for the SP to contest. In such a situation, reaching the 202-seat mark would become difficult for the SP. The SP wants Congress to contest with the same level of strength so that reaching the majority mark becomes easier. This is why SP chief Akhilesh Yadav had earlier said that there is only one formula for seat-sharing: victory. Congress should tell the SP which candidates it plans to field on which seats. The SP wants Congress to at least provide it with a list of 50 such seats. Sources associated with the SP say that Congress had been asked for this list, but it has not provided it yet. This is why the seat-sharing issue between the two parties has not been resolved. Rahul-Priyanka and Akhilesh have not yet spoken about seat-sharing Sources associated with the SP and Congress claim that the top leadership of both parties has understood one thing: the UP Assembly elections and the 2029 Lok Sabha elections will be contested together as an alliance. In other words, the SP-Congress alliance is likely to continue for a long time. The alliance will benefit in 2029 only if it manages to win UP in 2027. According to senior journalist Hisam Siddiqui, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav and Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi have not yet held talks on seat-sharing. He also claims that the seat-sharing formula in UP will be decided only with the consent of these three leaders. Apart from them, whatever other leaders are saying has no significance. So, is Congress trying to bring smaller parties on board to prepare its list? In recent days, several leaders of smaller parties active in UP have met Rahul and Priyanka. Apart from this, Congress has continued to bring several prominent faces into the party. Former minister Swami Prasad Maurya, who was active in UP politics under the banner of his own party, has also met Rahul and Priyanka along with his son Utkrisht Maurya. It is being said that the father-son duo will contest the UP elections on the Congress symbol. Similarly, Ghazipur’s Dr Sanjay Chauhan, who runs a party representing the Chauhan community, and Pankaj Niranjan of Apna Dal (Kamerawadi) have also met Rahul Gandhi. Pankaj Niranjan is the husband of MLA Pallavi Patel. It is believed that all these leaders will contest the Assembly elections on the Congress symbol. Earlier, Hemant Chaudhary had merged his Jan Sardar Party with Congress. Hemant Chaudhary had previously been active in politics with Apna Dal (S). His party had a significant influence among the Kurmi community. Hemant Chaudhary is considered to have influence over around 8-10 seats in Basti and Siddharthnagar districts. Eight-time former MLA Pandit Shyam Sundar Sharma, a prominent figure in Mathura politics, has also joined Congress. Congress wants to prepare its list with the help of these leaders from smaller parties so that it can demonstrate the weight of its demand when negotiating seat-sharing with the SP. SP may adopt the 2022 Assembly election formula Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says both parties will have to show flexibility in the alliance. The SP will have to give Congress more than 70 seats under any circumstances. The SP may also adopt the formula used in the 2022 Assembly elections, under which the candidates would belong to the SP, but the Congress symbol would be used. This means that if Congress does not have strong candidates, the SP could offer an alternative as part of the seat-sharing arrangement. In 2022, the SP had fielded its own candidates on several seats allotted to the SBSP. Pallavi Patel herself won the election on the SP symbol and entered the Assembly.

stories.title: ‘Hang daughter-in-law and her lover’:Meerut mother says, ‘They had my son bitten by snake; let her die as he suffered, only then will I find peace’
stories.summary: Amit Kashyap’s mother Munesh Devi came and sat outside the ADJ 12 court in Meerut on Wednesday, expecting the verdict in her son’s murder case and demanding that his daughter-in-law Ravita and her lover be hanged. Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar, Munesh said, “After the brutal way my son was murdered and made to be bitten by a snake, I want the murderous daughter-in-law and her lover to be hanged. Just as she made my son suffer, I want them to die in agony too. Only then will my soul find peace.” She said Ravita not only destroyed her own marriage with the help of her lover but also left three children orphaned, adding that she was now living only with the hope that her son’s killers would receive such a punishment that she would feel justice had been done. She hoped that the court would announce a severe punishment today. However, the court found Ravita and her lover Amardeep guilty of murder. October 16 has been fixed as the date for sentencing. The murder took place on April 17, 2025. The court delivered its verdict after recording the statements of more than 12 witnesses over 16 hearings. Read in detail what happened in court and the complete story of the case… Mother says, ‘If they are not sentenced to death, I will approach the High Court’ Mother Munesh Devi said, “My son Amit was the father of three children. Since he has been gone, his laughter and voice make me cry every moment. His three innocent children still ask, ‘Where is our father? Where is our mother?’ His father could not bear the shock of his son’s murder either and died after suffering emotionally. Now I want my son’s killers to be sentenced to death. If they are not hanged, I will also appeal in the High Court. I will ensure justice for my innocent grandchildren and myself.” Brother says, ‘If Ravita did not want to live with Amit, she could have left him. Why did she murder him?’ Amit’s brother Sandeep said, “If Ravita did not want to live with Amit, she could have told him. She could have left him. But she brutally murdered my brother. His post-mortem also confirmed that Amit died due to strangulation. After this, we came here hoping that the court would pronounce its verdict today. We hope the court will ensure justice for us. We want nothing less than the death penalty. I will continue to demand justice and seek the death penalty for my brother’s killers.” Government lawyer says, 'Ravita and Amardeep guilty of murder and destroying evidence' Farzana, the government lawyer who represented Amit’s side, said, “The court has found Amardeep and Ravita guilty. October 16 has been fixed for sentencing. Twelve witnesses were presented by our side in this case. Among them were the complainant Monu Kashyap and Munesh, who was also an eyewitness. On the night of the murder, she saw him coming to and leaving her son’s room. Ravita was in an illicit relationship with Amardeep. Amardeep used to visit Ravita’s house. “There were several fights as well. Later, the two conspired to eliminate Amit Kashyap, after which Ravita became involved in religious rituals. A few days later, Ravita planned that she needed a snake for the worship. The snake charmer then provided a rat snake. Amit was subsequently strangled to death. “Ravita and her lover Amardeep have been found guilty of murder and destroying evidence. On the night of the murder, the locations of Ravita and Amardeep were also found at the house.” Lawyer says, 'Both were located at the house on the night of the murder' The lawyer representing Amit said, “The phone locations of Ravita and Amardeep were found at the scene of the crime. Both were seen coming to and leaving the place. Their illicit relationship was several days old. They had also been warned about it, and the deceased Amit’s mother had seen them coming and going. On this basis, both were found guilty.” Read the complete story of the husband’s murder and the snake-bite plot Wife had said, 'He used to do things with me that were even worse than rape' While being taken to jail, the accused wife, Ravita, had said, “He (the husband, Amit) used to beat me every day. He used to do things with me that were even worse than rape. He would say, ‘I will turn you into a prostitute and make you work in the sex trade.’ He knew that I spoke to Amardeep on the phone. My husband himself made me speak to Amardeep on the phone. Then he told me that he would call Amardeep to our house. He said I would have to help him kill Amardeep. Then he would kill me too.” Lover had said, 'Amit sent men after me to kill me, so I killed him' Before being sent to jail, Ravita’s accused lover Amardeep had said, “A few days ago, I had an argument with Amit over a transaction of ₹3,500. Some people then got us to settle the matter. Even after that, Amit sent some men after me to kill me. “When I came to know about this, I plotted Amit’s murder to save my own life. Amardeep said there is a village called Mohammadpur in the Mawana area, where many snake charmers live. I bought the snake from them for ₹1,000. One of the snake charmers’ associates came here and sold me the snake.”

stories.title: BJP Rajya Sabha candidate says Samajwadi ‘more infamous than Munni’:Says uncle shown in name of backward class, wealthy man given ticket; asks, 'Where is Akhilesh’s PDA?'
stories.summary: “Rajya Sabha candidates have just been announced. Where was PDA visible there? The SP gave a ticket to a wealthy industrialist. In the name of the backward class, his uncle was brought in, while there was no one from the Dalit community. They stopped at two. Had there been a third candidate, perhaps they would have brought in a criminal…” This was said by BJP Rajya Sabha candidate and state president of the BJP OBC Morcha, Prakash Pal. In an exclusive interview with Dainik Bhaskar, he said that even after being in power four times in Uttar Pradesh, the Samajwadi Party has become discredited among every section of society. “Today, the SP is more infamous than ‘Munni’. Now even uncle Shivpal has to seek permission to enter the party office.” On Akhilesh calling former Uttar Pradesh Congress president Ajay Rai ‘Chirkut’, Prakash Pal said, “This shows how Akhilesh views his own alliance partners.” He said that the importance of the uncle and the family has now ended in the SP. He also attacked the SP chief over giving preference to an industrialist for a Rajya Sabha ticket and taking jibes at leaders of alliance partners. Read the full interview… Question: The SP is trying to woo OBCs and Dalits through the ‘PDA Yatra’. How will you counter it? Answer: We do not need to counter it. The SP has been in power four times. Even after that, it has become a discredited party among all sections of society. Earlier, some people said PDA meant ‘Power Family Development Authority’. But now even the uncle is not being given any importance. We are getting reports that Shivpal and Dharmendra are also not allowed to enter the party office without Akhilesh’s permission. When the uncle himself is not being given any importance in the party, the new meaning of PDA will now be ‘Power of Dimple Akhilesh’. The uncle is not there, and neither is the family. Question: Why did Akhilesh Yadav not field a third candidate? Answer: We feel that he himself got shocked by the prospect of a possible defeat and escaped by putting out a tweet. He said that the fight is not for three seats but for all 403 seats. I would say that if someone does not have the courage to contest three seats, how will they contest all 403? Question: Akhilesh called Ajay Rai ‘Chirkut’. How do you see this? Answer: This raises a very big question about the status with which he views his alliance partners and their presidents, that he calls them ‘Chirkut’. When he considers the state president of a party that is bigger than his own party, has more MPs, and whose family has produced Prime Ministers of India for several generations, to be a ‘Chirkut’, you can understand how he must view his other people. Question: The SP and BSP are demanding a caste census. Why is it not being conducted? Answer: Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav kept saying that we would conduct a caste census at all costs. But the day PM Modi announced it, no one is coming forward to take credit for it. The reason is that the Prime Minister has announced a caste census for Muslims along with a caste census of Hindus. Now, if these people come forward to take credit for it, Muslims will chase them away. Let me tell you that there are 33 Waqf Boards in the country. Not a single Pasmanda, who belongs to the backward class, is a chairman or member anywhere. This is the truth of their politics. Question: The state presidents of the SP and BSP are from the Pal community. Is this a challenge for the BJP? Answer: It is not just about reaching out to the Pal community. This community is firmly standing with the BJP. The BJP has given respect to the backward classes. Prime Minister Modi has consistently worked in the interests of the backward classes. Our effort is to ensure that government schemes reach every section of society and that people benefit from them.

stories.title: Imran says workers sometimes make mistakes amid uproar:SP alliance won’t mean surrender; will contest on respectable number of seats
stories.summary: UP Congress working president Imran Masood has outlined his strategy for the 2027 Assembly elections and his views on the Samajwadi Party-Congress alliance soon after taking charge. On the commotion at the party office, he said party workers sometimes make mistakes but stressed that former state president Ajay Rai’s contribution should not be overlooked. On seat-sharing, Masood said the alliance would not amount to surrender and that Congress would contest a respectable number of seats with strength. He also said Rahul Gandhi’s narrative would change Congress’s position in Uttar Pradesh. What role will Imran play in the 2027 elections? Read the full interview… Question: There was some commotion and shoes were thrown when you took charge today. Imran: No, it was not like that. Such things happen among party workers occasionally. Sometimes, a few workers make mistakes. The contribution of our former state president, Ajay Rai, cannot be undermined under any circumstances. He worked very hard to build the party ahead of the last election. Question: Regarding seat-sharing for the 2027 Assembly elections, figures such as 200, 150 and 80 seats have been discussed. Where will the negotiations settle? Imran: Look, the party leadership will decide this, not us. However, we want an agreement that ensures respect for both sides. It should not appear that Congress has completely surrendered. We want a strong alliance and intend to contest the elections together. We will work to form the government in Uttar Pradesh. The atmosphere is very favourable, so I do not think there will be any problem. Question: Has Akhilesh Yadav asked for a list of your candidates? Imran: No, no list has been requested or submitted yet. Discussions will begin now. I think that after the ongoing agitation, we will try to finalise the list in October. Question: If there is no alliance, will Congress contest all 403 seats? Imran: I do not think we need to consider an ‘if’ here. The alliance is in place, so I do not see the need for that question. Question: Congress was reduced to just two seats in 2022. What is the target for 2027? Imran: Look, in politics, you never know who will be reduced to a handful of seats or who will rise. The government in Delhi was in power for 15 years before it fell in a moment. Kejriwal won 67 of the 70 seats. You can never predict these things. It is a game of narratives, and Rahul Gandhi has built a narrative across the country. The entire INDIA alliance stands with him. I do not think Congress is in the same position it was in earlier. Congress is in a very strong position with the 2027 elections in mind. Question: If the alliance wins the election, will you be a candidate for the Deputy Chief Minister’s post? Imran: No, no. I am not a candidate for any post. My job is to strengthen the party and build the organisation, and that is what I will do. I will continue in that role. Question: Does Congress consider you an equal stakeholder in Uttar Pradesh? Imran: Look, if it did not consider me an equal stakeholder, it would not have appointed me working president under these circumstances. This was a courageous and significant decision. Congress does not believe in the politics of merely using Muslims; it believes in taking everyone along. Question: You have been given major responsibilities in UP. What will you focus on first? Imran: The party has given me this position with certain expectations. My first priority is to fulfil those expectations. We need to strengthen the organisation further and work to win as many seats as possible in the coming elections. Question: What role do you expect to play in selecting candidates for the 2027 elections? Imran: I do not know what role the party will assign me. That is for the party to decide. Question: Samajwadi Party fielded only two candidates in the Rajya Sabha elections, one of whom was Dhanraj. What is Congress’s view on this? Imran: That is an internal matter of their party. We cannot interfere in everything. Question: When your party’s candidates contested in Jharkhand, their father was involved, and he won after defeating them… Imran: Look, both you and I know what happened. It is not necessary for me to comment on everything.

stories.title: Owaisi targets 37 Purvanchal seats:AIMIM got just 3% votes in Azamgarh in 2022, without preparation; will SP suffer losses?
stories.summary: After failing to form an alliance with the Samajwadi Party (SP), Asaduddin Owaisi is now eyeing Muslim-majority constituencies considered SP strongholds. On 11 October, Owaisi met people in Azamgarh. Before this, he had addressed a public meeting in Moradabad. Focusing on Muslim issues in his politics, Owaisi secured 62,831 votes in Azamgarh in 2022. This accounted for 3% of the total votes. At the time, AIMIM did not even have a strong organisational presence in the Azamgarh constituencies. This is why Owaisi has visited Azamgarh ahead of the 2027 elections. He knows that the results in the 5 Azamgarh constituencies where the victory margin was 17,000 votes or less in the 2022 elections could be changed relatively easily. If Muslim voters unite behind his party, the political tide could turn in AIMIM's favour. Owaisi is active not just in Azamgarh but also across 37 constituencies in the neighbouring districts of Jaunpur, Ballia, Ghazipur and Mau. In the 2022 elections, AIMIM fielded candidates in 12 of these 37 constituencies. Nine of these candidates contested against the SP and reduced its winning margins. At the time, AIMIM contested 95 seats in Uttar Pradesh. For 2027, Owaisi is preparing to contest more than 200 seats. He is also preparing to field candidates in these 37 constituencies in eastern Uttar Pradesh. Read this report to understand the possible impact on the 2027 Assembly elections. SP's influence: Won 29 seats in 2022 In the 2022 elections, the SP was in an alliance with the Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP). Together, they won 29 of the 37 constituencies across Azamgarh, Mau, Ballia, Ghazipur and Jaunpur. In 12 of these 37 constituencies, the victory margin was less than 10,000 votes. However, two changes have taken place this time that could pose a challenge for the SP. If the Owaisi factor comes into play, the SP is likely to suffer directly. This is because the Muslim-Yadav combination has been a key winning factor for the SP in eastern Uttar Pradesh. If a section of Muslim voters shifts from the SP to AIMIM, the SP could face difficulties. Let us understand this in greater detail through the example of Azamgarh. Political analyst Rajendra Kumar says AIMIM does not merely want to win seats of its own. Weakening the SP's MY (Muslim-Yadav) equation is also among its objectives. However, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has advised his party spokespersons not to speak openly against AIMIM, as the BJP could benefit from such attacks. Understand why the SP is powerful in Azamgarh and neighbouring districts through the results of the 2022 Assembly elections. AIMIM could change the electoral equation in these constituencies

stories.title: Delivery boy found hanging, sister alleges affair with woman:Phone unlocked using her fingerprint; alleges he was murdered in Varanasi
stories.summary: A delivery boy who was living alone at home in Varanasi was found hanging in his bedroom. On Sunday, his younger sister Ranjana told Dainik Bhaskar at the post-mortem centre that her brother was having an affair with a married woman from the neighbourhood who has two children. She alleged that he was murdered. Shubham’s feet were positioned awkwardly, with one leg hanging towards the floor and the other bent on the bed. Blood was coming from his private parts. There were also scratch marks on his neck. The woman unlocked his mobile phone using her fingerprint and quickly cut the rope to bring down his body. His father, Umesh Prasad Maurya, said, “My son called me on Friday. He said, ‘Papa, I have to go to Bengaluru. I have a ticket for Monday.’ I told him to come to our village, Nevada, and meet me before leaving. I never imagined he would never return. On Saturday, I received a call saying that Shubham’s body had been found hanging.” Neighbour called sister and said her brother was unwell Umesh Prasad Maurya, a native of Nevada in Bihar, has been living for several years in a house he built at Vijayipura Chauraha in Koniya, under the Adampur area of Varanasi. His wife has died. His two daughters, Kalpana and Ranjana, are married and live in Mughalsarai in Chandauli and Varanasi, respectively. His youngest and only son, Shubham Maurya (27), worked as a delivery boy. His younger sister Ranjana said, “I run a boutique and a beauty products shop in Annapurna Nagar Colony in Varanasi. At 3.49 pm on Saturday, a man from the neighbourhood called and said that Shubham was unwell and asked me to come over. I sent my son there.” Sister says rope was not tied like a suicide noose Ranjana said, “A little later, I closed my shop and reached the house. There was a large crowd outside. The door was latched from the outside. When we opened it and went in, Shubham was hanging from a rope in the room. One of his legs was hanging towards the floor, while the other was bent on the bed. Blood was coming from his private parts, and there were scratch marks on his neck. The rope was also not tied in the way someone would normally tie it to hang themselves.” Neighbour unlocked brother’s phone with her thumb Ranjana said Shubham had been living alone at home, as their father had gone to Nevada. “My brother was having an affair with a woman from the neighbourhood. He had been with her for the past five days, and in the evening, his body was found hanging. When we arrived, we tried to unlock his mobile phone, but it would not open because his body had become stiff. When the neighbour came, she unlocked his phone in front of us using her thumb.” She alleged that the same woman cut the rope and brought down the body before the police arrived. Ranjana also said the woman’s husband had run away with another girl and had returned only 10 days earlier. He was now living with his wife. Father says, ‘My son was not weak’ Sitting in a corner of the hospital, Shubham’s father was devastated by the death of his only son. With tears in his eyes, he said, “My son was not weak enough to hang himself. I was in Nevada.” He said his son had called him on Friday and told him that he needed to go to Bengaluru. “He said he had a ticket for 12 October. We had asked him to come home to Nevada on 11 October. I told him to come and meet me before leaving. I never thought this would happen.” Shubham’s father then broke down in tears. He has appealed to the Chief Minister for justice. Adampur Station House Officer Vimal Mishra said the body had been sent for post-mortem and handed over to the family. He said the family had alleged that Shubham was having an affair with the woman and claimed that he had been murdered. Police are examining the deceased’s mobile phone and CCTV footage from the surrounding area. Further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

stories.title: Man arrested for breaking into Ayyappa temple:Stole from donation box to fund expensive lifestyle
stories.summary: Police arrested the accused of breaking into the Lord Ayyappa Temple in Vineet Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, and stealing cash from the donation box. The accused has been identified as 20-year-old Arsalan, a resident of Bheem Nagar in Uzariyanv. Police recovered ₹5,145 from his possession. Omanakuttan NK, general secretary of the Lord Ayyappa Service Society, lodged a theft complaint at the Gomti Nagar police station on 10 October. He said an unidentified person broke the lock on the temple door, entered the premises and stole the cash kept in the donation box after breaking its lock. ₹5,145 recovered from accused Police registered an FIR in the case and began searching for the accused. On Sunday, acting on a tip-off from an informant, a police team arrested Arslan on the road leading towards the railway line in Vineet Khand-5. ₹5,145 was recovered from him. Police produced the accused in court and sent him to jail. He used to splurge the money During questioning, the accused said he committed thefts to fund his expensive tastes. He would squander the stolen money on entertainment. Before stealing from the temple, he first conducted a recce of the surrounding area. He then scaled the wall and entered the premises.

stories.title: Snake and mongoose fight in Lakhimpur:Mongoose bites cobra’s mouth as snake strikes back with hood; fight lasts 45 minutes
stories.summary: A video of a fight between a cobra and a mongoose in Lakhimpur emerged on Sunday. The two were seen attacking each other in a field. The mongoose clamped the snake's hood in its jaws, causing the snake to writhe. Somehow freeing itself, it began hissing at the mongoose. The mongoose repeatedly evaded its attacks. Each time, the mongoose appeared to overpower the cobra. The snake was badly injured in the mongoose's attack. The struggle between the two continued for about 45 minutes. In the end, the mongoose won and the cobra died. The incident took place at 2 p.m. on Sunday in the South Nighasan Forest Range. Snake-mongoose fight in 3 pictures Villagers recorded the video on their mobile phones Some villagers had gone to collect fodder for animals in a sugarcane field near the road from Ludhauri to Semra Purwa village. During this time, they noticed a cobra and a mongoose fighting. Seeing the two animals clash, the villagers began recording the video on their mobile phones. Mongoose repeatedly attacked the cobra's hood The video shows the mongoose repeatedly attacking the cobra's tail and hood. The cobra kept hissing and trying to protect itself from the mongoose. To escape the mongoose's attacks, the cobra also tried to climb a sugarcane stalk, but the mongoose gave it no opportunity. Mongoose kills cobra in 45 minutes According to eyewitnesses, the cobra was found injured and wrapped around a sugarcane stalk after the fight, which lasted around 45 minutes. The cobra subsequently died. The villagers then began sharing the recordings they had made on their mobile phones.

stories.title: Three-way contest in Bithoor chairman by-election:BJP and Congress field candidates as SP leader runs as an independent; polling on 13 October
stories.summary: Polling for the by-election to the Bithoor Nagar Panchayat chairperson's post will be held on 13 October. There are now three candidates in the contest. The BJP and Congress have fielded their candidates on party symbols, while the Samajwadi Party (SP) has not given any candidate an official party symbol. Adarsh Dwivedi, a leader associated with the SP, is contesting the election as an independent candidate. The seat fell vacant after the death of former Nagar Panchayat chairperson Dr Nirmala Singh. She had served as Nagar Panchayat chairperson for five consecutive terms. At the time of her death in June 2026, around 13 months remained in her term. See three pictures... Son Rana Samrendra Singh also in the electoral fray Dr Nirmala Singh's son, Rana Samarendra Singh, is contesting the by-election for the chairman's post. Her younger son, Abhijeet Singh Sanga, is the MLA from the Bithoor Assembly constituency. Given Dr Nirmala Singh's long political career, the by-election is being considered significant for local politics. The Congress has nominated Pradeep Dwivedi for the chairman's post. Pradeep has been associated with the party for around 30 years. He had also contested the Nagar Panchayat chairman's election held in 2023. Samajwadi Party-linked Adarsh Dwivedi contests as an independent Adarsh Dwivedi is contesting the election as an independent candidate. He is the Kanpur Rural vice-president of the Samajwadi Party's Lohia Vahini. He is also a Samajwadi Party councillor from Ward Number 5, Dhruvnagar, of the Bithoor Nagar Panchayat. The Samajwadi Party has not given him the party's official symbol in this by-election. Adarsh Dwivedi is the nephew of former Bithoor MLA Munindra Shukla. Seven candidates initially filed nominations for the by-election to the post of chairperson of the Bithoor Nagar Panchayat. However, after the electoral process moved forward, only three candidates now remain in the contest. The candidates' fate will be decided after polling on Tuesday. Now, learn about Bithoor Nagar Panchayat... Bithoor Nagar Panchayat has 10 wards and around 10,000 voters. In the 2023 election for the chairperson's post, 12 candidates had entered the fray. So far, seven candidates have filed nominations for this by-election. However, the final number of candidates will become clear only after the deadline for withdrawal of nominations. Dr Nirmala Singh has continuously served as chairperson of Bithoor Nagar Panchayat since 2000. Before her, Surendra Pal Singh, also known as Kaka Ji, was the chairperson here. After his death, the then vice-chairman, Ghasitelal, was made chairman. The 10 wards of Bithoor Nagar Panchayat include Brahmnagar, Subedarnagar, Peshwa Nagar, Maharshi Valmiki Nagar, Tatya Tope Nagar, Dhruv Nagar, Laxmibai Nagar, Mainavati Nagar and Lav-Kush Nagar. By-election polling on 13 October, counting on 15 October The nomination process for the by-election to the post of Bithoor Nagar Panchayat chairman began on 18 September. Nomination papers were filed until 24 September, with a total of seven candidates submitting nominations. The scrutiny of nomination papers was conducted on 25 September. The withdrawal process took place on 28 September. According to the election schedule, polling for the post of Bithoor Nagar Panchayat chairman will be held using ballot papers on 13 October. Voting will take place from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Counting will begin at 8 a.m. on 15 October, after which the election results will be announced.

stories.title: Couple found hanging from the same noose in Unnao:Lovers were cousins; woman had married a year ago
stories.summary: A young man and woman in a relationship died by suicide in Unnao after hanging themselves. They were found hanging from a tree by the same rope. They were related as maternal and paternal cousins. Villagers passing through the orchard saw the bodies hanging and informed the police. A crowd gathered at the scene. The police had both bodies brought down and sent them for post-mortem. They also questioned the villagers. The incident took place at 2 p.m. on Sunday in the Bihar police station area. The girl got married a year ago Babulal Pasi, who lives in Chhattakheda village, has a son, Abhay Kumar (24), and a daughter. Abhay worked at a factory. His paternal aunt's house is in Mahramau village, near his own village. His aunt had five children-three sons and two daughters. Priti (22) was the youngest. Her elder sister is Aarti, and her three brothers are Kuldeep, Sachin and Sandeep. Priti's father is a farmer. Her brother Kuldeep works in a private job in Delhi. Sachin works at a roadside eatery, while Sandeep has a job in Dubai. Abhay and Priti were in a relationship. However, their families got Priti married on 30 November 2025 in Shahtan village, under the jurisdiction of Bighapur police station. Priti had been staying at her parents' home in recent days. At around 10 a.m. on Sunday, Priti and Abhay quietly left their respective homes. In the afternoon, the two reached a mango orchard near a railway crossing in Dhamnikheda village. They spoke to each other for some time and then both hanged themselves. When Priti did not return home for a long time, her family filed a complaint at Purwa police station. Station House Officer Rahul Singh said, “The initial investigation suggests that the two were having an affair. They were related as brother and sister. We have spoken to their family members and villagers. No suicide note was found at the spot. The reason for their deaths is not yet clear.”

stories.title: Two tourists clash in Taj Mahal garden:Dispute over stepping on each other’s feet in a queue leads to a fight
stories.summary: Two groups of tourists got into an argument at Agra's Taj Mahal after one tourist stepped on another's foot while they were standing in a queue. The argument soon turned into a physical fight. The tourists from both groups continued fighting until they reached the restricted garden area of the Taj Mahal. Here, CISF personnel intervened and separated the two sides. Women from both groups also tried to calm the dispute. A video of the incident is rapidly going viral on social media. The incident is said to have occurred at around 3:15 p.m. Tourists had come from Rajasthan, CISF personnel calmed the situation According to CISF personnel Devendra Bhadoria, one tourist's foot stepped on another tourist's foot while they were queuing at the Taj Mahal. This led to a dispute between the two groups. What began as a verbal altercation soon escalated into a scuffle. The tourists from both groups fought their way into the garden. During the incident, women from both sides intervened. After receiving information, CISF personnel also stepped in, separated the two sides and brought the dispute under control. It was reported that both groups comprised tourists from Rajasthan. Two men, one from each side, had clashed during the dispute. The CISF brokered a settlement between the two sides and calmed them down. The presence of tourists in the garden during the incident created a chaotic situation. The incident has drawn attention after a video of the fight emerged.

stories.summary: A young man and woman jumped into the Gomti river from the Gomti Bridge at Ghaila in Madiyaon, Lucknow, on Sunday evening. According to eyewitnesses, the young man jumped from the bridge first. The woman then took off her slippers and jumped into the river. A crowd gathered on the bridge after the incident. On receiving the information, police arrived and launched a search for both with the help of divers. Woman jumped after the young man According to eyewitnesses, the woman also jumped from the bridge after the young man entered the river. As soon as information about the incident was received, the Madiyaon and Thakurganj police reached the spot. Divers are searching for both in the river with the help of a boat. The young man and woman could not be traced until late evening. Identities still unknown The identities of the young man and woman who jumped into the Gomti have not been established. Police are trying to identify both while also investigating the reason for the incident. Madiyaon Inspector Shivanand Mishra said that the boy's shoe was found on the bridge. He said they suspected that the two had jumped after a quarrel, although their identities have not yet been established. The State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) has also reached the spot. Thakurganj police said they had received information that the young woman had jumped from the bridge. A slipper was found at the spot, and a team is working to establish her identity.

stories.title: Security guard arrested for shooting dog in Lucknow:Fired licensed gun; identified through CCTV footage
stories.summary: Police arrested on Sunday the security guard accused of shooting and killing a street dog in Lucknow's Talkatora area. The accused has been identified as 42-year-old Sandeep Kumar Tiwari, a resident of Muneshwarpuran, Badshahkheda. He works as a security guard at Principal Security and Allied Services Private Limited. Police seized the licensed DBBL gun used in the incident, one spent cartridge case, four live cartridges and the arms licence. According to police, a motorcyclist shot the street dog in the Talkatora area on 6 October, killing it. Charu Khare, on behalf of AASRA The Helping Hands Trust, and animal rights activist Anu Bose lodged a complaint at the Talkatora police station in the case. See two pictures... Police traced the accused through CCTV footage Considering the seriousness of the incident, police examined footage from CCTV cameras installed at and around the scene. The routes used by the accused to reach the scene and leave after the incident were investigated. Based on the footage and other evidence, police identified Sandeep Kumar Tiwari. Fired after being chased by dogs During questioning, the accused told the police that on 6 October, while returning home after his night duty, dogs began chasing him. In a fit of anger, he fired his licensed gun. The dog died after being hit by the bullet.

stories.title: Kangana Ranaut calls Yogi her brother in Ayodhya:Visits Ram Lalla, says she will return with family
stories.summary: Bollywood actress and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut arrived in Ayodhya on Sunday. At 1:30 p.m., she paid obeisance at Hanumangarhi and offered prayers to Ramlalla. At the Ram temple, Kangana kept gazing at the idol of Ramlalla. During the visit, Kangana also hinted that she might marry soon. She said, "It now seems that I will have to come here at least once with my family." This was Kangana's third visit to Ayodhya. Before this, she inaugurated a showroom. Kangana said roads had been built in Ayodhya and facilities like those at an airport had been developed. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision is now becoming a reality. Kangana described Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath as her brother. She said the people of Ayodhya were benefiting from his service. Ayodhya Dham is becoming famous around the world today. Those who live here are blessed. Kangana arrived in Ayodhya wearing a South Indian outfit; see 2 pictures... Kangana toured the Ram temple for 30 minutes Kangana first visited the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi complex. The temple trust presented her with a Ramnami robe and gave her prasad. She spent around 30 minutes offering prayers and touring the temple. She then paid obeisance at Hanumangarhi. Kangana said, "Ayodhya, the land of Ram Lalla, is sacred. It is always a privilege to come here. Coming here has been an extremely holy and divine experience, which is difficult to put into words." Kangana also praised the grand complex of the Ram temple. She said, "The temple complex is extremely vast and beautiful. Families should spend at least two to three days in Ayodhya to experience spiritual peace and satisfaction. Only then can the divinity of this place be fully felt." She said that she now felt she would have to visit the place with her family at least once. See three more pictures... Kangana on CJP protest: A conspiracy is under way to harass the people of the country A day before arriving in Ayodhya, Kangana Ranaut came to Lucknow. There, she hit out at the CJP's call for a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi. She said, "The challenges posed by anti-national elements, terrorist forces and international conspiracies are a serious cause for concern." Kangana alleged that conspiracies were being hatched to harass the country and its citizens under various pretexts. When has Kangana visited Ayodhya?

stories.title: Roadways bus runs over vegetable trader in Kanpur, killing him:Family says police PRV was nearby but failed to take him to hospital in time
stories.summary: A vegetable trader was killed after a speeding Roadways bus hit him in Nawabganj, Kanpur, late on Saturday night. It is alleged that the driver ran over the trader while trying to flee after the collision. After the accident, the injured man lay on the road covered in blood. His family alleged that a police PRV was present nearby, but he was not taken to hospital in time. He was later taken to LLR Hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Angered by the incident, the family surrounded the Nawabganj police station and created a commotion. They demanded the bus driver's arrest and compensation. After officials assured them of action, the police registered a case and began searching for the accused driver. The trader was returning home on foot after closing his shop Thirty-five-year-old Sunit Nishad, who lived near the zoo in the Nawabganj police station area, ran a wholesale vegetable business at Amrood Mandi. His family comprises his wife, Kajal; daughter, Kirti; son, Rudransh; mother, Shakuntala; father, Kanhaiyalal; and brothers, Sunil, Sudhir and Amarjeet. According to the deceased's brother Sunil, Sunit was walking home after closing the shop late on Saturday evening. He had reached near a petrol pump behind the road leading to the Ganga Barrage when a speeding roadways bus coming from behind hit him. He fell on the road and suffered serious injuries. The family alleges that instead of stopping to help the injured man, the bus driver tried to flee and ran him over in the process. Sunit lay on the road covered in blood. 'His life could have been saved if he had been taken to hospital in time' The family alleges that a police PRV was present some distance from the scene, but no steps were taken to immediately take the injured man to hospital. They said Sunit's life could have been saved if he had received timely treatment. According to the family, police personnel took Sunit to LLR Hospital at the request of passers-by, where doctors declared him dead. On learning of this, the family became enraged and reached Nawabganj police station, where they staged a protest. The family members demanded the arrest of the accused bus driver, strict action against him and compensation for the family. The commotion outside the police station continued until late at night. ADCP assures action After receiving information about the commotion, ADCP Central Dr Archana Singh reached the spot with police personnel. She spoke to the family members, heard their complaint and assured them of action. The family members then calmed down. Based on the family members' written complaint, the police registered a case and began searching for the accused bus driver. ADCP Central Dr Archana Singh said a case had been registered on the basis of the family members' written complaint. The body was being sent for a post-mortem examination. Further action would be taken based on the post-mortem report and the facts that emerge during the investigation.

stories.title: Coaching centre owner dies by suicide in Meerut:Found hanging at coaching centre; police launch investigation
stories.summary: A coaching centre operator died by suicide inside his coaching centre in Meerut's Kankarkheda police station area on Sunday. His body was found hanging from a noose. The landlord informed the police after seeing the body. On receiving the information, the police reached the spot, brought the body down and sent it for post-mortem examination before launching an investigation. Ashwani, a resident of DC Enclave in the Kankarkheda police station area, ran a coaching centre in New Sainik Colony's Gali Number 1. He left home for the coaching centre on Sunday and died by suicide after hanging himself there. The landlord informed the police after seeing Ashwini's body hanging from the noose. With the help of local residents, the police brought Ashwini down and took him to Kailash Hospital, where doctors declared him dead. No one was present at the coaching centre at the time of the incident. The reason behind Ashwani's suicide has not yet been ascertained. The police have informed the deceased's family about the incident. As soon as the family learnt of the incident, chaos broke out among its members. The family members have left for the scene, while the police sent the body for a post-mortem examination and are investigating the case.

stories.title: Mirzapur residents shower flowers on Divya Mittal, leaving her emotional:Says ‘no one should cry now’; visits after entering politics for first time
stories.summary: Former IAS officer Divya Mittal reached Mirzapur on Sunday, the first day of Navratri. It was her first visit after announcing her entry into politics. Supporters gave her a rousing welcome as soon as she arrived. As soon as her car stopped, slogans of 'Long live Divya Didi' were raised. Women garlanded her with roses and showered her with flowers. A video of the welcome has also emerged. In it, people can be seen touching her feet. Divya Mittal also appeared emotional during the occasion. Divya told the people, You have weighed me with flowers and garlands. This is your love. You make me emotional every time. It feels as though Mirzapur has taken it upon itself to make me cry. Mirzapur should always keep smiling. No one is allowed to cry. After this, former IAS officer Divya Mittal visited the shrine of Maa Vindhyavasini. She joined ordinary devotees without any VIP protocol and offered prayers after standing in the queue. IAS officer Divya Mittal of the 2013 batch resigned on 30 August. On 29 September, she clarified that she was entering politics. See 4 pictures... Bhaskar poll: People said Divya Mittal should contest from the Samajwadi Party and prepare to fight from Mirzapur Which party should former IAS officer Divya Mittal contest for, and from where? Daily Bhaskar asked its readers two questions on 2 October. The first question was: Which party could give Divya Mittal the greatest success in politics? There were four options: the BJP, the Samajwadi Party, Raja Bhaiya's party and an independent run. The Samajwadi Party was chosen by the highest number of readers, at 30%. In other words, nearly three out of every 10 readers believed that Divya Mittal should enter politics with the Samajwadi Party. The BJP finished second, securing 28% of the votes. The option of contesting as an independent was also chosen by 28% of respondents. Meanwhile, 14% of readers chose the option of backing Raja Bhaiya's party. This means the gap between the SP and BJP was just 2%. The independent option received the same number of votes as the BJP. Interestingly, Divya Mittal has said that instead of joining any party, she would enter politics as the 'voice of the people'. She said she would decide her political path in consultation with the people. Mirzapur's district magistrate and had brought water to Lahuriyadah Divya became Mirzapur's district magistrate in September 2022. She attracted attention there for her work on public outreach meetings and drinking water in rural areas. The initiative to supply piped water to Lahuriyadah village was also undertaken during her tenure. Her departure remained a topic of discussion even after her transfer from Mirzapur. She was given a farewell in the presence of local residents. Her tenure in Deoria also drew attention. A dispute over powers between public representatives and the administration there once again put her in the spotlight. Entered politics after quitting her IAS job Divya, a 2013-batch IAS officer, resigned from her job on 30 August. Her resignation was accepted on 14 September. Speculation about her future plans had been rife ever since. After earning a BTech from IIT Delhi and an MBA from IIM Bengaluru, Divya had taken up a job in London with a package worth lakhs. Divya left her job in London to join the civil services Divya's husband is from Punjab and had cleared the UPSC examination on his first attempt

stories.title: Pickup runs over scooter rider in Kanpur:Drags him 200 metres while fleeing; man narrowly escapes death
stories.summary: A pickup truck hit a young man riding a scooter in Kanpur. As it tried to flee, it dragged the scooter rider along for 200 metres. Fortunately, the man narrowly escaped with his life, but the scooter was completely wrecked. The man said, "For a moment, I felt that I would not survive. But by the grace of Mata Rani, my life was saved." CCTV footage of the incident has emerged. The victim reached Ghatampur police station and filed a written complaint. Police are searching for the pickup truck. The accident took place on 10 October on Moosanagar Road. See 2 pictures Stopped at the municipal market to buy some goods Shubham, a resident of Jawahar Nagar West in the Ghatampur police station area, said that he works in Hamirpur. He was returning home on his scooter late on Saturday evening. He stopped at the municipal market on Moosanagar Road to buy some household items. At around 9 p.m., as he turned the scooter to leave, it went under the bonnet of a pickup. Instead of stopping the vehicle, the pickup driver accelerated and dragged him for around 200 metres. I was shouting, "Save me! Save me!" but the pickup driver did not stop the vehicle. During this, the scooter came loose from the pickup. People raised an alarm, but by then the pickup driver had fled the scene with the vehicle. The scooter was damaged in the incident. Fortunately, I survived. The man reached Ghatampur police station late at night, submitted a complaint and demanded action. Ghatampur Inspector Manoj Singh Bhadoria said: We received information. The pickup is being traced on the basis of CCTV footage. A case will be registered and action will be taken on the basis of the complaint.

stories.title: Ruckus at UP Congress office, shoes hurled, pushing and shoving:Ajay Rai and Mamta Chaudhary clash; Rai says he was abused, Pramod Tiwari folds hands
stories.summary: Congress workers clashed with each other during the charge-taking ceremony of Aradhana Mishra and Imran Masood at the UP Congress office. Shoes and slippers were thrown, and a scuffle broke out. The tense situation continued for 30 minutes. After the commotion, former UP Congress president Ajay Rai staged a sit-in, alleging that he had been mistreated. Seeing the situation escalate, MP Pramod Tiwari and Imran Masood tried to pacify Ajay Rai. See 3 pictures… Dispute between Mamta Chaudhary and Ajay Rai Mamta Chaudhary is a councillor from Lucknow’s Malviya Nagar and is said to be close to Aradhana Mishra. In 2023, a dispute broke out between Mamta and Ajay Rai over an issue. Following this, Ajay Rai barred Mamta from entering the party office. Ajay Rai skips press conference; Imran Masood defends him Ajay Rai did not attend the press conference held during the charge-taking ceremony. When media personnel asked Imran Masood about his absence, he defended Ajay Rai, saying, “There has been no tradition of former presidents attending press conferences. I have taken charge from him at the party office.” Imran Masood said, “The party has placed its trust in me. We will strive to live up to that trust. We will certainly bring change in Uttar Pradesh and strengthen the UP Congress. The INDIA alliance will contest the elections unitedly.” Mamta Chaudhary is a councillor from Lucknow Mamta Chaudhary is a councillor from Lucknow’s Malviya Nagar. Reports suggest that she had an argument with Ajay Rai over an issue in 2023. Following this, Rai barred her from entering the party office. She has been visiting the party office since Aradhana Mishra became the state party president. The story being updated...

stories.title: Jhansi’s Kali Baba revealed as history-sheeter, arrested:Wore army-style uniform, held divine court; devotees came from abroad
stories.summary: History-sheeter Kali Sarkar Baba, alias Pradeep Shukla, was arrested in Jhansi during a raid on Sunday afternoon. He had been living in a temple in disguise. He wore an army-style uniform and held a divine court, claiming to cure every illness. People from across the country and abroad visited his divine court. He has more than 1 lakh followers on the social media platform Instagram. Kali Sarkar Baba is a resident of Chauhan Thok in Hardoi. Three years ago, the Hardoi court issued a warrant against him after he failed to appear in a case of assault. He had been absconding ever since. Read the full case in detail History-sheeter at Hardoi Kotwali police station Accused, Pradeep Shukla alias Natroj, son of Mayaram Shukla, is a resident of Chauhan Thok in the Kotwali police station area of Hardoi. He is a history-sheeter at the Kotwali police station and has several cases registered against him. In 2014, police arrested him in connection with a robbery case in the Kotwali area and sent him to jail. Later, in 2018, a case of assault was registered against him. The accused was not appearing in court in either case. Court No. 2 in Hardoi, presided over by a Judicial Magistrate, issued a permanent warrant in the robbery case, while the Judicial Magistrate First Class issued one in the assault case. Hardoi police had been searching for him for nearly three years. Changed his name and became a baba Accused Pradeep Shukla fled Hardoi and moved to Jhansi. There, he became a baba at the Kali Sarkar temple in Kuraincha village, under the Mauranipur police station area. He changed his name to Satyanand Shukla alias Kali Sarkar and established himself as a saint. He also began holding Divya Darbars, which started attracting hundreds of people. Hardoi police received information about him some time ago. During the search, the police reached Jhansi and traced his location after an investigation. On Sunday, the Mauranipur and Hardoi police arrested Pradeep Shukla. One lakh followers on Instagram About a year ago, the accused also created an Instagram page under the name Kali Sarkar. It has more than one lakh followers. The accused held Divya Darbars on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays, while a separate session for local residents was held on Wednesdays. He claimed to cure every illness and resolve other problems through these sessions.

stories.title: Son kills mother’s lover for marrying her:Returns from New Zealand, shoots him dead in broad daylight in Rampur; CCTV footage emerges
stories.summary: A 30-year-old trader in Rampur was killed by his step-son along with his paternal aunt's son. The son was upset over his mother's second marriage. The trader's father, Nishan Singh, alleged that his step-sons conspired with their paternal aunt's son to carry out the murder. CCTV footage of the incident has also emerged. At around 5 p.m. on Saturday evening, two attackers who arrived by car opened rapid fire at trader Navjot Singh, who was sitting at his shop. Navjot fell to the ground as soon as he was hit. The attackers then fled in the car. The incident took place in Kumhariya Tah village, under the jurisdiction of Milak Khanam police station, around 40 kilometres from the district headquarters. Navjot's father has filed a complaint with the police against seven accused, including his step-son Avdeep, his brother and his paternal aunt's son Rajandeep. Both step-sons live in New Zealand. Additional SP Anurag Singh said: Navjot's step-son Avdeep carried out the murder along with his paternal cousin Rajandeep. Both are absconding. The police are searching for them. Stepsons were angry over their mother's second marriage Navjot Singh owned a shop called 'Gill Washing Hub' in Kummharia Tah village. His father, Nishan Singh, is a farmer. One sister works in Canada. According to the police's preliminary investigation, Navjot entered into a love marriage with a 40-year-old woman, Kamal Kaur, around a year ago. The woman's first husband had died around three years earlier. Her two sons, Avdeep and Jogango, work in New Zealand. Navjot's father said that both of Navjot's stepsons were opposed to the marriage. They did not want their mother to remarry. According to him, Avdeep had returned from New Zealand just five days earlier. He planned the murder with his cousin Rajandeep, his paternal aunt's son. The father has also said that his daughter-in-law's life is at risk and sought protection for her. Now read what the CCTV footage shows... In the CCTV footage, Navjot can be seen sitting near the counter inside his shop. Another person is also present in the shop. Navjot is standing and talking to him. During this time, a silver Alto car arrives and stops outside the shop. Two people with their faces covered get out of a car. One of them enters the shop carrying a pistol. The person sitting inside runs away and hides. Seeing the weapon, Navjot runs to catch the attacker. During the struggle, the attacker fires at him. The two grapple with each other. Just then, the second attacker comes from behind and opens fire. After being shot, Navjot falls to the ground. The second attacker fires again. Navjot then gets up and runs inside the shop, but collapses there. Both attackers try to fire at him again, but the gun does not discharge. The two then calmly get into the car and flee the scene. Father files complaint against five people, including two stepsons After receiving information about the incident, police reached the spot and took the injured Navjot to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Police are searching for the accused. Station House Officer Naresh Kumar said: The family remained at the police station until around 11 p.m. on Saturday. The trader's father has filed a complaint against seven people, including his stepson.

stories.title: Prayagraj STF officer sought cattle as bribe:Also demanded German Shepherd, ₹35,000 for furniture; corruption case filed
stories.summary: A case has been registered in Hisar, Haryana, against a sub-inspector posted with the Prayagraj STF on corruption charges. Sub-inspector Ranendra Kumar Singh demanded two cows and a German Shepherd dog in exchange for removing the accused's name from a liquor smuggling case. During a phone call, the sub-inspector said, "Give me ₹35,000 to buy a chair and table, and give me a buffalo as well. I will remove your name from the case." The complainant submitted 45 audio recordings of conversations with the sub-inspector and screenshots to the Haryana Anti-Corruption Bureau. The bureau's investigation found the available recordings and other evidence to be genuine. Following this, a case was registered against the sub-inspector in Hisar on 6 October under Section 7 of the Prevention of Corruption Act. In fact, a case had been registered against Manveer Singh at Nawabganj Police Station in Prayagraj on 2 September 2023 for allegedly smuggling illicit liquor. The sub-inspector demanded the bribe in exchange for removing his name from this case. Case registered against complainant at Nawabganj police station Complainant Manveer Singh, also known as Mannu, is a resident of Byanakheda village in Haryana's Hisar district. A case was registered against him at Prayagraj's Nawabganj police station on 2 September 2023 on charges of smuggling illegal English liquor. According to police records, Sub-Inspector Ranendra Kumar Singh had filed the complaint in the case. Manveer's name also emerged during the investigation. Manveer alleged that the sub-inspector demanded a cow, buffalo, dog and other items from him in exchange for having his name removed from the case. On 17 February 2026, Manveer lodged a complaint with the Anti-Corruption Bureau, Hisar Range. He also submitted an audio recording of his conversation with the sub-inspector and screenshots. According to the investigation report, in a recording dated 1 February 2026, the sub-inspector asked for ₹35,000 to buy a chair and table by sending a scanner to his mobile phone through another youth. In a second recording, he asked for ₹10,000 to be deposited into the scanner of a youth named Himanshu. Case registered after approval from the DG's office The investigation found that the sub-inspector called Manveer on 1 February and asked him to give him two cows. On 3 February, Manveer sent two cows to the sub-inspector. Manveer also submitted the audio recording to the Anti-Corruption Bureau. On 9 February, the sub-inspector called Manveer again and said, "Send one more cow and one buffalo." After this, your name would be removed from the case. On 15 July, the Hisar division of the Anti-Corruption Bureau sent its investigation report to the office of the Director General of Police, Anti-Corruption Bureau, Haryana, in Panchkula. Approval to register a case was received on 14 August. Based on this approval, a case was registered at the Anti-Corruption Bureau police station in Hisar division on 6 October. Liquor was being transported from Haryana to Bihar According to police records, a case was registered against Manveer Singh at Nawabganj police station in Prayagraj on 2 September 2023 on charges of smuggling illicit liquor. Police records state that Sub-Inspector Ranendra Kumar Singh had filed the complaint in the case. It said that English liquor was being illegally smuggled from Haryana to Bihar. Based on information received from Manveer, the sub-inspector and his team seized the liquor in Nawabganj. Manveer's name later emerged during the investigation. As he was wanted in the case registered at Nawabganj police station in Prayagraj on 2 September 2023, a reward of ₹50,000 was announced for his arrest by the Additional Commissioner of Police, Prayagraj, on 16 July 202. He was subsequently arrested again and sent to jail in August, but was later released on bail. Now, a corruption case has been registered against the sub-inspector in Haryana on allegations that he demanded a bribe in exchange for removing Manveer's name from the same case.

stories.title: Akhilesh targets BJP over men beating girls:Says the party learnt this from Hitler; Brajesh Pathak asks how long he will defame UP
stories.summary: On Sunday, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav shared a video of a protest by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) in Delhi. He claimed that the people treating a daughter in this manner in the video belong to UP. Targeting the BJP, Akhilesh said, “Can these monochrome people, who go around challenging others, not see this video showing how a daughter is being treated? These are people from UP. It is being heard that they reside around Ghaziabad.” Akhilesh alleged that BJP leaders have learned from Hitler. He said, "Hitler used to dress up his political workers to take revenge on workers of other political parties. Even during Hitler's era, troopers used to similarly humiliate workers of other political parties and lathi-charge them." The SP chief made these statements in Lucknow. He had arrived at the Jayaprakash Narayan International Centre (JPNIC), where he garlanded the statue of Loknayak Jayaprakash Narayan on his birth anniversary. The BJP hit back at Akhilesh, asking — "how long will you defame UP?" See 2 pictures… Brajesh Pathak said: UP's image was tarnished during SP rule Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak asked, “How long will Akhilesh Yadav continue to defame Uttar Pradesh? Whenever the Samajwadi Party is in power, the image of Uttar Pradesh deteriorates across the entire country and the world. At that time, a situation like 'One District, One Mafia' gets created.” He added that under the leadership of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath in the Bharatiya Janata Party government, Uttar Pradesh has progressed on every front. Law and order prevail in the state, and the youth of Uttar Pradesh have established their identity not only in the country but also globally on the strength of their working capacity and skills. Meanwhile, BJP spokesperson Rakesh Tripathi said that after looking at the caste and religion of the accused, Akhilesh Yadav has now started looking at region as well. He accused Akhilesh of trying to tarnish the state's image by alleging that those misbehaving in Delhi belong to UP. "Akhilesh Yadav is trying to defame the people of UP. 'Boys will be boys, they make mistakes'—this has been the principle of the SP. By making remarks about the youth of UP, Akhilesh has pitted them against himself. Trying to ruin UP's image will prove costly for Akhilesh," Tripathi stated. Nand Kishor Gurjar targets Akhilesh Yadav, says: Look within before pointing fingers The SP shared photos of two young men seen in the video alongside Nand Kishor Gurjar, the BJP MLA from Loni in Ghaziabad. Gurjar hit back at Akhilesh Yadav over this. Nand Kishor Gurjar stated that the SP's social media handle posted his picture along with those of the two youths in an attempt to send a message that the individuals involved in the assault were connected to him. Targeting Akhilesh Yadav, he said that the SP chief should look within before accusing others. Gurjar claimed that Akhilesh's photos have also surfaced alongside controversial figures multiple times in the past. Akhilesh says: Only 40 days left for the government; the public is going to defeat them On the birth anniversary of Jayaprakash Narayan, Akhilesh was able to garland his statue after 3 years. Following his announcement to visit JPNIC, a heavy police force was deployed at JPNIC on Saturday night. On Sunday morning at 11:00 AM, Akhilesh reached JPNIC with party workers. During this time, the presence of police personnel was sparse and the barricades had also been removed. Seeing Akhilesh, the police opened the gate, and he went inside. Although police tried to stop some party workers, they managed to enter as well. Akhilesh garlanded the statue of Jayaprakash Narayan and offered roses. Following this, he said, "People in the government want to sell everything. How many rupees must this have been sold for? The public is going to defeat them in 2027. Change has begun, and now only 40 days remain." Regarding the CM's offer to contest from Ayodhya, the SP chief remarked: Everyone will be swept away by Pawan's (Pawan Pandey's) wind. Arrogant people will not survive. Ask the BJP people—does the CM distribute tickets? He himself has to stand in line. Doesn't he ask for a ticket for himself? He stands in line to ask for tickets for his people too. Prior to this, Akhilesh had garlanded Jayaprakash Narayan's statue at JPNIC in 2023, when he scaled an 8-foot-high gate to enter the center. In 2024 and 2025, the administration did not grant him permission to go inside JPNIC. Akhilesh's 4 major points— 1- JP's movement shook the government of that time Akhilesh Yadav said—"Jayaprakash ji always stood up for the oppressed and downtrodden. The greater the pain, the sooner the change will come. It is because of change itself that we have come this far. JP ji was the father of Total Revolution (Sampoorna Kranti). His movement shook the government of that time, leading to the formation of the Janata Party government for the first time. "JP ji provided leadership against peak inflation and administrative dictatorship in the country, which brought about change. Driven by socialist values, he gave the call for a Total Revolution advocating economic equality and unity for all. Today, we are following his principles. JP ji fought alongside Gandhiji against the British." 2- A government that harbors fear commits injustice "A government that harbors fear commits injustice. Who doesn't know that the BJP people commit injustice? The job of the Election Commission is to facilitate maximum voting, but they are working to prevent voting in elections. Who doesn't know that the Election Commission facilitated vote theft?" 3- The Chief Election Commissioner should resign voluntarily "The Chief Election Commissioner should resign voluntarily. Everyone has understood the dishonesty of the BJP. Everyone is about to leave. Why did they pay off JPNIC's contractors and take them along? Name any other government that has built a structure like JPNIC. The helipad here is not for those with faint hearts. There is car parking for 1,200 vehicles here. If you compare it to the airport for just one hour, the government could earn 800 crore rupees right from here." 4- They kept the barrage closed, drowning Faizullaganj; then they submerged the Riverfront Akhilesh said—"When I praised the Riverfront, they opened all the gates of the barrage. It was completely submerged. Water reached all the way to the Riverfront and Palassio. Before that, they had kept the barrage closed, so Faizullaganj got flooded. The reality is that there is an ongoing conflict between the Municipal Corporation, the LDA, and the Irrigation Department. The officials of the departments are unable to calculate where the water will flow. Someone else is constructing the embankments in Faizullaganj. An engineer is not designing it—the Chief Minister is designing it. The CM gives the order to open the gates as well, while the Irrigation Department is doing nothing. You tell me, what will happen if the CM starts designing drains and bridges?"

stories.title: Businessman dies after Chinese manjha slices his neck in Varanasi:Returning from Navratri prayers; second kite-string death in UP in 20 hours
stories.summary: A 55-year-old sari trader died after Chinese manjha slit his neck while he was returning from a temple in Varanasi on Sunday (11 Oct) morning. The man fell off his motorcycle onto the road as he began bleeding profusely. A young man who saw him writhing in pain rushed him to a hospital on a motorcycle, but doctors declared him dead. The victim’s younger brother, Sushil Kumar, said his brother had left home around 7 am to visit a temple. While returning, the kite string cut his neck on the Kazzakpura flyover. He had gone to the temple because his son was unwell. Police have sent the body for a post-mortem examination. The incident comes a day after a young man died in Gorakhpur when Chinese manjha slit his neck on Saturday (10 Oct) afternoon. Businessman dies after Chinese manjha cuts his neck while returning from temple Sunil Kumar Gujarati (55), a sari trader from Ashapur, had ridden his motorcycle to Gopal Temple in Chowkambha on Sunday morning to offer prayers. While returning home, a Chinese kite string became entangled around his neck on the Kazzakpura flyover, causing a fatal cut. Vikas Kumar Sonkar, who was passing by with his family, said, “We were returning home via the Kazzakpura Bridge. When we reached the top, Sunil Kumar was lying on the road in a pool of blood. He was writhing in pain, with blood flowing from his throat. I immediately stopped some motorcyclists, and with their help, we took him to Kabirchaura Hospital. However, doctors declared him dead.” Aman Jaiswal said he was out for a walk on the bridge when the incident occurred at around 9 am. “A kite string suddenly got entangled around the neck of Sunil Jaiswal, who was riding a motorcycle. Before we could understand what had happened, he fell to the ground and began writhing in pain. Blood was spurting from his neck. We called the police and immediately took him to the hospital on a motorcycle,” he said. Younger brother says businessman had gone to temple to pray for his ailing son The businessman’s younger brother, Sushil Kumar, said, “My elder brother lived with his family in a separate house in Ashapur and ran a sari business. His son, Yash Gujarati, had been unwell for the past two days, so my brother had gone to the temple to offer prayers.” The accident occurred while he was returning from the temple. Sushil Kumar said the family learnt about the incident when two young men reached Chowkhambha looking for them and informed them that his brother had met with an accident.

stories.title: Model girlfriend first met him at Lucknow club:Mother alleges blackmail, threats and cigarette burns
stories.summary: The mother of a 28-year-old man who died after falling from the fourth floor of an apartment in Lucknow has accused his girlfriend, model Shraddha Dubey, of blackmailing and physically abusing him. “My son first met her at a club in Lucknow. As they grew closer, they started dating. She had connections with influential people and used to threaten him because of them. My son got caught up in a case, after which she started blackmailing him. Towards the end, she even burnt him with cigarettes. Several marks were found on his body. She had applied lipstick to his face,” said Ranjana Sharma, the deceased’s mother. Police have registered a case based on Ranjana’s complaint against Shraddha, her sister Rashmi Dubey, a man named Adil and two unidentified people. The allegations are yet to be established. “Anyone would cry after being beaten as badly as my son was. He was beaten so much, and I used to see it every day, but…” Ranjana said. 3 pictures of the accused girlfriend that show her luxurious life: Mother says girlfriend blackmailed him for four months Ranjana said Shraddha had been blackmailing her son for around four months. According to the police investigation, the two met through mutual friends at a club in Gomti Nagar and later began dating. They frequently met at a café in Kisan Bazaar. In September, Shiva reportedly told mutual friends that he was being harassed and blackmailed. Ranjana alleged that Shraddha had burnt her son with cigarettes at several places on his body. She said she objected when the initial panchnama (inquest report) did not mention the alleged cigarette burns. The marks were subsequently shown, according to the report. ‘He was afraid of the influence of powerful people’ Ranjana said she had requested a full-body examination of her son and handed over some of the chats between Shiva and Shraddha to the police. According to the report, the police are investigating claims that Shraddha knew political leaders and senior bureaucrats in Uttar Pradesh, as well as members of the Indian cricket team. Shiva’s mother alleged that Shraddha used these connections to intimidate him. On August 30, Shiva was named as an accused in a firing incident at Tinkle Pink Club in Gomti Nagar. The Special Task Force arrested him in Patna, Bihar, and he was sent to jail. A reward of ₹50,000 had also been announced for information leading to his arrest. Ranjana alleged that Shiva had become afraid of going to jail and that Shraddha took advantage of this fear to pressure him. Police are also investigating the roles of Shraddha and Shiva’s associates in the firing incident, including whether the shooting was arranged to implicate him. This remains under investigation. Audi with secretariat pass reaches apartment after incident A white Audi arrived at the apartment around 15 minutes after the incident, according to the report. A secretariat pass was displayed on the front of the vehicle. Police are gathering details about the car to establish who arrived in it or left in it. Residents who were present at the time reportedly said Shiva was wearing only underwear and had lipstick on his face. His mother said he had left home in a BMW two days before the incident and had been staying away since then. No arrests two days after incident Police have registered a case following the family’s complaint, but no accused had been arrested in the two days after the incident, according to the report. ACP Hazratganj Rajneesh Verma said the accused would be arrested and sent to jail. Police are continuing their investigation.
